patents.abstract: The present disclosure provides compositions and methods effective for transducing cells in vivo with a recombinant retrovirus comprising a polynucleotide encoding a chimeric antigen receptor and a chimeric costimulatory receptor.
patents.assignee: KELONIA THERAPEUTICS INC [US]; KELONIA THERAPEUTICS, INC.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent discloses recombinant retroviruses encoding both a chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) and a chimeric costimulatory receptor for in vivo cell transduction. The dual-receptor approach may enhance CAR-T efficacy by providing integrated costimulatory signaling, potentially addressing T cell exhaustion and persistence challenges in solid tumors and other difficult-to-treat indications.
patents.title_original: THÉRAPIE GÉNIQUE À DOUBLE CIBLAGE

patents.title: RECOMBINANT RETROVIRUS, COMPOSITIONS AND METHODS OF USE
patents.abstract: The present disclosure provides compositions and methods for transducing immune effector cells in vivo with a recombinant retrovirus comprising a polynucleotide encoding a chimeric antigen receptor and a multipartite cell surface receptor.
patents.assignee: KELONIA THERAPEUTICS INC [US]; KELONIA THERAPEUTICS, INC.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent discloses a recombinant retrovirus vector encoding both a chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) and a multipartite cell surface receptor for in vivo transduction of immune effector cells. The competitive significance lies in enabling direct in vivo CAR-T cell engineering, potentially eliminating the need for ex vivo manufacturing while the multipartite receptor may enhance targeting, persistence, or therapeutic control.
patents.title_original: RÉTROVIRUS RECOMBINANT, COMPOSITIONS ET PROCÉDÉS D'UTILISATION

patents.title: RECOMBINANT RETROVIRUSES, COMPOSITIONS AND METHODS OF USE
patents.abstract: The present disclosure provides recombinant retroviruses, retroviral vectors, packaging cell lines, and in vivo methods of use for expansion of immune effector cell populations for treatment of a disease, disorder, or condition.
patents.assignee: KELONIA THERAPEUTICS INC [US]; KELONIA THERAPEUTICS, INC.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent discloses recombinant retroviral vectors and packaging cell lines specifically designed for in vivo expansion of immune effector cell populations. The competitive significance lies in the approach to expand CAR-T or engineered T cells directly within the patient using retroviral delivery, potentially offering advantages in scalability and manufacturing compared to ex vivo expansion methods.
patents.title_original: RÉTROVIRUS RECOMBINANTS, COMPOSITIONS ET PROCÉDÉS D'UTILISATION

patents.title: RECOMBINANT RETROVIRUS, COMPOSITIONS AND METHODS OF USE
patents.abstract: The present disclosure provides recombinant retrovirus or retroviral particles comprising fusogens and tropism polypeptides and polynucleotides encoding hapten-binding receptors and optionally transduction enhancers and one or more T cell activating proteins. The present disclosure further provides adaptor molecules and methods of using the same with the recombinant retrovirus or retroviral particles and T cells transduced with the recombinant retrovirus or retroviral particles.
patents.assignee: KELONIA THERAPEUTICS INC [US]; KELONIA THERAPEUTICS, INC.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent presents recombinant retroviral vectors engineered with dual targeting capabilities—fusogenic and tropism polypeptides—combined with hapten-binding receptors and T cell activating proteins, enabling enhanced transduction and activation of T cells in a single viral particle. This approach offers competitive advantage for in vivo CAR-T by potentially streamlining manufacturing (consolidated payload) and improving transduction efficiency through integrated activation signals, reducing the need for ex vivo expansion.
patents.title_original: RÉTROVIRUS RECOMBINANT, COMPOSITIONS ET PROCÉDÉS D'UTILISATION

patents.title: RECOMBINANT RETROVIRUSES, COMPOSITIONS AND METHODS OF USE
patents.abstract: The present disclosure provides a recombinant retrovirus comprising retroviral vectors encoding components of a macromolecular complex, which when expressed in a cell and in the presence of a ligand may promote growth and/or survival of the cell.
patents.assignee: KELONIA THERAPEUTICS INC [US]; KELONIA THERAPEUTICS, INC.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent discloses recombinant retroviruses encoding components of macromolecular complexes that promote cell growth/survival upon ligand binding. For in vivo CAR-T applications, this represents a potentially novel viral delivery approach for multi-component therapeutic complexes, though the abstract lacks specificity regarding T cell targeting, CAR architecture, or persistence mechanisms critical to CAR-T efficacy.
patents.title_original: RÉTROVIRUS RECOMBINANTS, COMPOSITIONS ET PROCÉDÉS D'UTILISATION

patents.title: AUF LYMPHOZYTEN ZIELGERICHTETE LENTIVIRALE VEKTOREN
patents.assignee: KELONIA THERAPEUTICS INC [US]; Kelonia Therapeutics, Inc.

patents.title: CHIMERIC PROTEIN AND MODIFIED IMMUNE CELL, AS WELL AS THEIR PREPARATION METHOD AND THEIR USE
patents.abstract: Provided are a chimeric protein and an engineered immune cell. The chimeric protein contains an Fc-binding domain of an Fcγ receptor, can bind to the Fc fragment of an IgG antibody, and does not contain a protease-cleavable site in the Fc-binding domain of the Fcγ receptor, thereby effectively promoting continuous killing of a target cell when the engineered immune cell expressing the chimeric protein is used in combination with IgG.
patents.assignee: SHENZHEN GENOCURY BIOTECH CO LTD [CN]; 深圳市济因生物科技有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent presents a chimeric protein containing an Fcγ receptor Fc-binding domain without protease-cleavable sites, designed to maintain stable IgG binding and enable sustained target cell killing when expressed in engineered immune cells. This addresses a key limitation in antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity (ADCC) by preventing protease degradation of the Fc-binding interaction, offering improved therapeutic efficacy for combination approaches with monoclonal antibodies.
patents.title_original: PROTÉINE CHIMÉRIQUE ET CELLULE IMMUNITAIRE MODIFIÉE, AINSI QUE LEUR PROCÉDÉ DE PRÉPARATION ET LEUR UTILISATION

patents.title: Method for Preparation of CAR-T Cells and Its Use
patents.abstract: Disclosed are a method of preparing CAR-T cells, and a composition used in said method. The method comprises: S1, administering, as a pretreatment, lymphocyte depletion therapy to a subject having cancer; and S2, administering to the subject (a) a cell population comprising T cells collected from a haploidentical donor thereof and (b) a viral vector. The method allows for effective preparation of CAR-T cells in a subject.
patents.assignee: SHENZHEN GENOCURY BIOTECH CO LTD [CN]; 深圳市济因生物科技有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: This patent discloses an ex vivo to in vivo CAR-T generation approach combining lymphodepleting pretreatment with haploidentical donor T cells and viral vector administration, enabling CAR-T cell preparation directly within the subject rather than requiring ex vivo transduction. The competitive significance lies in potentially reducing manufacturing complexity and cost while enabling allogeneic CAR-T therapy through haploidentical donor sourcing, though the in vivo transduction approach presents regulatory and safety challenges compared to established ex vivo methods.
patents.title_original: PROCÉDÉ DE PRÉPARATION DE CELLULES CAR-T ET SON UTILISATION

patents.title: METHOD FOR PREPARING A T LYMPHOCYTE EXPRESSING A CAR AND USE THEREOF
patents.abstract: The present invention relates to the field of cell therapy, and specifically relates to a method for preparing a CAR-expressing T cell and a use. Disclosed in the present invention is a method for preparing a CAR-T cell, comprising the following steps: S1, collecting a T cell-containing cell population of an autologous or allogeneic donor of a subject; S2, administering lymphodepletion therapy to the subject for pretreatment; and S3, administering the T cell-containing cell population and a viral vector to the subject.
patents.assignee: SHENZHEN GENOCURY BIOTECH CO LTD [CN]; 深圳市济因生物科技有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes a CAR-T cell preparation method that integrates lymphodepletion pretreatment (S2) with direct in vivo administration of T cells and viral vector to the subject (S3), suggesting an ex vivo collection followed by in vivo transduction approach. The competitive significance lies in potential simplification of the manufacturing process by reducing ex vivo culture and transduction steps, though the clinical benefit of this approach versus standard ex vivo CAR-T manufacturing requires validation.
patents.title_original: PROCÉDÉ DE PRÉPARATION D'UN LYMPHOCYTE T EXPRIMANT UN CAR ET UTILISATION

patents.title: Vector Comprising Multiple Targeting Molecules and Method for Improving the Transduction Efficiency of a Vector
patents.abstract: Provided are a vector comprising multiple targeting molecules, and a method for improving transduction efficiency of a vector. Provided is a vector comprising multiple targeting molecules. The efficiency of transducing non-activated T cells by the vector is improved. Also provided is a method for improving transduction efficiency of a vector. The method can effectively improve the efficiency of transducing non-activated T cells by the vector.
patents.assignee: SHENZHEN GENOCURY BIOTECH CO LTD [CN]; 深圳市济因生物科技有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent discloses a vector design incorporating multiple targeting molecules to improve transduction efficiency of non-activated T cells, which addresses a key challenge in ex vivo CAR-T manufacturing where activation-dependent transduction limits cell product quality and scalability. The multi-targeting approach represents a potentially significant advancement for improving viral vector-mediated gene delivery to primary T cells without requiring pre-activation, reducing manufacturing complexity and potentially preserving therapeutic functionality.
patents.title_original: VECTEUR COMPRENANT DE MULTIPLES MOLÉCULES DE CIBLAGE ET PROCÉDÉ D'AMÉLIORATION DE L'EFFICACITÉ DE TRANSDUCTION D'UN VECTEUR

patents.title: USE OF A CYTOKINE ANTAGONIST IN THE PREPARATION OF A MEDICAMENT FOR THE PREVENTION AND/OR TREATMENT OF SLC
patents.abstract: The present invention relates to the field of cell therapies, and in particular to use of a cytokine antagonist in the preparation of a drug for preventing and/or treating death from CRS. Disclosed is use of a cytokine antagonist in the preparation of a drug for preventing and/or treating death from CRS, the cytokine antagonist being a TNFα antagonist.
patents.assignee: SHENZHEN GENOCURY BIOTECH CO LTD [CN]; 深圳市济因生物科技有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent claims use of TNFα antagonists as cytokine antagonists for preventing/treating cytokine release syndrome (CRS) and associated mortality in cell therapy contexts. This addresses a clinically significant toxicity management strategy for adoptive cell therapies like CAR-T, potentially improving safety profiles by preemptively modulating excessive TNFα responses.
patents.title_original: UTILISATION D'UN ANTAGONISTE DE CYTOKINE DANS LA PRÉPARATION D'UN MÉDICAMENT POUR LA PRÉVENTION ET/OU LE TRAITEMENT DU SLC

patents.title: NANOCORPS CIBLANT CD7 ET SON UTILISATION
patents.abstract: The present invention relates to the field of nanobodies, and specifically relates to a CD7-targeting nanobody and a use thereof. Disclosed is a CD7-targeting nanobody. The nanobody has a small molecular weight and low immunogenicity, and is more suitable for clinical applications such as cell therapy and gene therapy.
patents.assignee: SHENZHEN GENOCURY BIOTECH CO LTD [CN]; 深圳市济因生物科技有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: A CD7-targeting nanobody with reduced immunogenicity and small molecular weight optimized for cell and gene therapy applications. This represents a potentially novel targeting molecule that could be applied to CAR-T engineering or T-cell redirected therapies, offering advantages over full-size antibodies in terms of manufacturing, tissue penetration, and clinical safety profiles.

patents.title: EXTRACELLULAR VESICLE, PREPARATION METHOD RELATING THERETO AND ASSOCIATED USE
patents.abstract: An extracellular vesicle. The surface of the extracellular vesicle comprises at least part of a viral envelope glycoprotein or a variant thereof; the at least part of the viral envelope glycoprotein or the variant thereof does not bind to a receptor or the binding to a receptor is inhibited; and the extracellular vesicle is difficult to infect a cell by binding to a glycoprotein receptor. When the extracellular vesicle is used for delivering a target protein, the targeting performance of the extracellular vesicle is significantly improved. When an extracellular vesicle membrane expresses a hydrophobic protein, the expression and purification of the hydrophobic protein are facilitated.
patents.assignee: SHENZHEN GENOCURY BIOTECH CO LTD [CN]; 深圳市济因生物科技有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes extracellular vesicles (EVs) displaying non-functional viral envelope glycoproteins that cannot bind cognate receptors, improving targeting performance and facilitating expression/purification of membrane-associated hydrophobic proteins. This represents a novel approach to EV engineering that could enhance delivery efficiency and manufacturing for therapeutic cargo, with potential applications in CAR-T delivery and other gene therapy modalities where EVs serve as carriers.
patents.title_original: VÉSICULE EXTRACELLULAIRE, PROCÉDÉ DE PRÉPARATION S'Y RAPPORTANT ET UTILISATION ASSOCIÉE

patents.title: VIRAL VECTOR ENCAPSIDATION SYSTEM AND ITS USE
patents.abstract: Provided are a packaging system for packaging a lentiviral vector or a retroviral vector, and a use of the packaging system. Specifically, the provided packaging system comprises a polynucleotide encoding a CAR binding molecule, wherein the CAR binding molecule can bind to a CAR. Pseudotransduction is reduced when a host cell is transduced by the lentiviral vector or the retroviral vector packaged by the provided packaging system, and the ability to transduce a target cell expressing an antigen decreases, thereby significantly improving the targeting performance of the lentiviral vector or the retroviral vector in the transduction of immune cells such as T cells.
patents.assignee: SHENZHEN GENOCURY BIOTECH CO LTD [CN]; 深圳市济因生物科技有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The novelty lies in a viral vector packaging system that incorporates a polynucleotide encoding a CAR-binding molecule within the vector itself, reducing pseudotransduction while maintaining target cell transduction capacity. This approach improves targeting specificity for immune cell transduction, particularly for T cell engineering applications, by enabling self-targeting vectors that can selectively transduce CAR-expressing cells.
patents.title_original: SYSTÈME D'ENCAPSIDATION DE VECTEUR VIRAL ET SON UTILISATION

patents.title: POLYPEPTIDE AND VIRAL VECTOR CONTAINING A GENE ENCODING A POLYPEPTIDE
patents.abstract: Provided in the present invention are a TCP polypeptide and a viral vector containing a gene encoding the TCP polypeptide. The viral vector further contains a T cell-activation signaling molecule, and can effectively target, activate and transduce T cells.
patents.assignee: SHENZHEN GENOCURY BIOTECH CO LTD [CN]; 深圳市济因生物科技有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes a viral vector engineered to carry a TCP (T cell-targeting/activation) polypeptide gene alongside a T cell-activation signaling molecule, designed for specific targeting and transduction of T cells. This represents a modular viral vector approach for T cell engineering with integrated activation signaling, potentially offering advantages in CAR-T manufacturing by combining targeting, transduction, and activation in a single vector platform.
patents.title_original: POLYPEPTIDE ET VECTEUR VIRAL CONTENANT UN GÈNE CODANT POUR UN POLYPEPTIDE

patents.title: Viral Particle, Its Preparation Method and Its Use
patents.abstract: A viral particle. The surface of the viral particle comprises a T cell activation primary signaling molecule and a T cell activation secondary signaling molecule; the envelope glycoprotein of the viral particle is subjected to a first mutation, so that the receptor binding ability of the viral glycoprotein is weakened or lost with respect to its receptor binding ability before the first mutation; and the envelope glycoprotein of the viral particle can also be subjected to a second mutation, so that the viral particle has enhanced resistance to complement-mediated inactivation or is not subjected to complement-mediated inactivation. The viral particle has improved specificity for targeted activation, stimulation and transduction of non-activated T cells, and is thus more applicable for the preparation of CAR-T cells in subjects.
patents.assignee: SHENZHEN GENOCURY BIOTECH CO LTD [CN]; 深圳市济因生物科技有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The invention describes engineered viral particles displaying T cell activation signaling molecules (primary and secondary) on their surface, with mutations in envelope glycoproteins that ablate native receptor binding while enhancing complement resistance. This represents a novel approach to create targeted viral vectors that specifically activate and transduce non-activated T cells without off-target engagement, potentially offering improved safety and efficacy profiles for in vivo CAR-T cell manufacturing and stimulation compared to conventional viral vectors or bead-based activation systems.
patents.title_original: PARTICULE VIRALE, SON PROCÉDÉ DE PRÉPARATION ET SON UTILISATION

patents.title: Single Domain Antibodies Targeting CD79B, Chimeric Antigen Receptor and Its Use
patents.abstract: A single-domain antibody targeting CD79B, a chimeric antigen receptor, and a use thereof. Provided are an anti-CD79B single-domain antibody, a chimeric antigen receptor constructed using the single-domain antibody, and an engineered immune effector cell. Also provided is a use of the single-domain antibody, the chimeric antigen receptor, and the engineered immune effector cell in the preparation of a drug for the treatment of CD79B and/or B cell-related diseases.
patents.assignee: SHENZHEN GENOCURY BIOTECH CO LTD [CN]; 深圳市济因生物科技有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent claims a single-domain antibody (sdAb) targeting CD79B as the antigen-recognition domain of a CAR construct, combined with engineered immune effector cells expressing this CAR. The competitive significance lies in using a sdAb (smaller, potentially superior tissue penetration and manufacturing efficiency) rather than conventional scFv or full-length antibody formats for B-cell malignancy targeting via CD79B, a validated but less common CAR-T target compared to CD19.
patents.title_original: ANTICORPS À DOMAINE UNIQUE CIBLANT CD79B, RÉCEPTEUR ANTIGÉNIQUE CHIMÉRIQUE ET SON UTILISATION

patents.title: VECTEUR VIRAL ET SON UTILISATION DANS L'INFECTION DE LYMPHOCYTES B
patents.abstract: A lentiviral vector or retroviral vector, and a use thereof in infecting B cells, establishing acquired immunity in a subject, and preparing a broadly neutralizing antibody. The viral envelope of the lentiviral vector or retroviral vector comprises targeting molecules targeting B cells and carries a broadly neutralizing antibody gene; the viral glycoprotein of the lentiviral vector or retroviral vector may further comprise a first mutation that attenuates the receptor binding ability thereof and a second mutation that enhances the ability thereof to antagonize complement inactivation, and further enhances the ability of the lentiviral vector or retroviral vector to target and transduce B cells in a subject and prepare a broadly neutralizing antibody.
patents.assignee: SHENZHEN GENOCURY BIOTECH CO LTD [CN]; 深圳市济因生物科技有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: This patent describes engineered lentiviral/retroviral vectors with B cell-targeting envelope modifications and glycoprotein mutations (attenuated receptor binding, enhanced complement antagonism) designed to deliver broadly neutralizing antibody genes into B cells for acquired immunity. The novelty lies in the specific combination of targeting molecules, viral glycoprotein engineering, and therapeutic payload for B cell gene therapy—distinct from CAR-T approaches but relevant to the broader cell engineering and viral vector technology space.

patents.title: VIRAL VECTOR AND USE OF THE TCR SUBUNIT
patents.abstract: The present invention relates to the field of genetic engineering, and in particular to a viral vector and a use of a TCR subunit. Provided is a lentiviral vector or a retroviral vector. The ability to infect a target cell by the lentiviral vector or the retroviral vector is reduced. Also disclosed is a use of a TCR subunit or a functional fragment thereof in the preparation of the lentiviral vector or the retroviral vector.
patents.assignee: SHENZHEN GENOCURY BIOTECH CO LTD [CN]; 深圳市济因生物科技有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The invention discloses lentiviral or retroviral vectors with reduced infectivity capacity, incorporating TCR (T cell receptor) subunits or functional fragments to modulate target cell infection. This approach is significant for CAR-T applications as it enables more controlled transduction of T cells while potentially reducing off-target effects and improving safety profiles in ex vivo and in vivo gene therapy contexts.
patents.title_original: VECTEUR VIRAL ET UTILISATION DE LA SOUS-UNITÉ TCR

patents.title: VECTOR AND METHOD FOR IN VITRO TRANSFECTION OF NON-ACTIVATED T LYMPHOCYTES
patents.abstract: The present invention relates to the field of genetic engineering, and specifically relates to a vector and a method for transfecting non-activated T cells in vitro. Disclosed in the present invention are a vector and a method of using the vector to come into contact with non-activated T cells and transfect the non-activated T cells. The surface of the vector comprises one or more antibodies or antigen-binding fragments thereof and/or ligands or receptor binding fragments thereof that specifically bind to endocytic receptors of non-activated T cells; and the vector can carry a nucleic acid encoding a CAR, enters the non-activated T cells by means of endocytosis initiated by the specific binding of the endocytic receptors of the non-activated T cells, and then effectively transfects the non-activated T cells. Therefore, the technical problem whereby it is difficult to effectively transfect non-activated T cells in the process of preparing CAR-T cells in vitro is effectively solved, ther
patents.assignee: SHENZHEN GENOCURY BIOTECH CO LTD [CN]; 深圳市济因生物科技有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The invention discloses a vector decorated with antibodies or ligands that specifically bind endocytic receptors on non-activated T cells, enabling efficient CAR gene delivery via receptor-mediated endocytosis without requiring T cell activation. This addresses a significant challenge in CAR-T manufacturing by eliminating the need for pre-activation steps, potentially reducing manufacturing time and cost while improving transfection efficiency in primary T cells.
patents.title_original: VECTEUR ET PROCÉDÉ DE TRANSFECTION IN VITRO DE LYMPHOCYTES T NON ACTIVÉS

patents.title: VSVG MUTANT ET VECTEUR DE CIBLAGE
patents.abstract: Provided are a mutant VSVG and a targeting vector, belonging to the field of vector delivery. An envelope glycoprotein of vesicular stomatitis virus having a first mutation and a second mutation is provided, the first mutation causes the envelope glycoprotein to be unable to mediate complement inactivation; and the second mutation weakens the ability of the envelope glycoprotein to be recognized by a receptor. A targeting vector is also provided, which comprises: a first molecule that binds to an endocytic receptor of a target cell and a second molecule that is non-complement inactivated and promotes the release of a substance carried by the targeting vector into the cytoplasm; the second molecule promotes the endosomal escape or lysosomal escape of the targeting vector and prevents the targeting vector from being inactivated by a complement.
patents.assignee: SHENZHEN GENOCURY BIOTECH CO LTD [CN]; 深圳市济因生物科技有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent presents a dual-mutant VSVG envelope glycoprotein with reduced complement inactivation and weakened native receptor recognition, designed for pseudotyped viral vector applications. This engineering approach enables targeted delivery vectors with improved safety profile and cell-type specificity, potentially advantageous for CAR-T cell manufacturing where off-target transduction and complement-mediated immune responses are manufacturing liabilities.

patents.title: VECTEUR ET UTILISATION CORRESPONDANTE
patents.abstract: A vector and the use thereof in the field of gene delivery. The vector is a virus vector having a viral envelope, wherein (a) the surface of the virus vector having the viral envelope contains one or more ligands specifically binding to a lymphocyte endocytic receptor; (b) the envelope glycoprotein of the virus vector having the viral envelope has a first mutation, so that the ability of the envelope glycoprotein to specifically bind to a receptor is weakened or lost; and (c) the envelope glycoprotein of the virus vector having the viral envelope can also have a second mutation, so that the ability of the virus vector having the viral envelope to antagonize the inactivation by the complement is enhanced or the virus vector having the viral envelope is not inactivated by the complement.
patents.assignee: SHENZHEN GENOCURY BIOTECH CO LTD [CN]; 深圳市济因生物科技有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes an enveloped viral vector engineered with lymphocyte-targeting ligands on its surface, combined with mutations to ablate native receptor binding and enhance complement resistance. This is significant for CAR-T and T cell engineering as it enables targeted, efficient transduction of lymphocytes while reducing off-target toxicity and improving in vivo persistence through complement evasion.

patents.title: TARGETING VECTOR, ITS PREPARATION METHOD AND ITS USE
patents.abstract: Provided are a targeting vector and a method for targeting same to a host cell. The vector comprises a first molecule that binds to an endocytosis receptor of the target cell and a second molecule that promotes the release of a substance carried by the targeting vector into a cytoplasm. When the targeting vector is a viral vector, the first molecule is not part of a viral envelope protein, and the second molecule promotes endosomal escape or lysosomal escape of the targeting vector. The first molecule is designed according to the endocytosis receptor of the cell to be targeted, different types of cells can be targeted, and after a reasonable mutation is carried out on the vector, infection of cells that do not need to be targeted can be avoided, thereby improving the accuracy of the vector.
patents.assignee: SHENZHEN GENOCURY BIOTECH CO LTD [CN]; 深圳市济因生物科技有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes a targeting vector with modular design combining an endocytosis receptor-binding molecule and an endosomal/lysosomal escape-promoting molecule, enabling cell-type-specific delivery while avoiding off-target infection through rational mutation of viral vectors. This is relevant to CAR-T delivery as it addresses the challenge of achieving selective in vivo transduction of target T cells while minimizing systemic toxicity and off-target effects.
patents.title_original: VECTEUR DE CIBLAGE, SON PROCÉDÉ DE PRÉPARATION ET SON UTILISATION

patents.title: MEDICAMENT, METHOD AND USE FOR TREATING DISEASES CAUSED BY THE PRODUCTION OF AUTOANTIBODIES RESULTING FROM EXCESSIVE PROLIFERATION OF B LYMPHOCYTES
patents.abstract: Provided are a drug, a method, and use for treating diseases caused by autoantibody production resulting from excessive proliferation of B cells. The drug for treating diseases caused by autoantibody production resulting from excessive proliferation of B cells comprises: an mRNA encoding a chimeric antigen receptor molecule and a T cell targeting lipid nanoparticle. The drug can produce a chimeric antigen receptor T cell in vivo. The lipid nanoparticle comprises: a cationic lipid, a phospholipid, cholesterol, a PEG lipid, and a targeting molecule. The targeting molecule mediates T cell targeting. The lipid nanoparticle encapsulating the mRNA of the chimeric antigen receptor molecule (mRNA-LNP) is used to deliver the mRNA into a T cell in vivo to produce the chimeric antigen receptor T cell, and pathological autoreactive B cells are eliminated to achieve the treatment of diseases caused by autoantibody production resulting from excessive proliferation of B cells.
patents.assignee: SHENZHEN MAGICRNA BIOTECHNOLOGY CO LTD [CN]; 深圳虹信生物科技有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent presents an in vivo CAR-T approach using mRNA-LNP technology with T cell-targeting lipid nanoparticles designed to treat B cell-mediated autoimmune diseases. The competitive significance lies in enabling direct in vivo CAR-T cell generation without ex vivo cell manipulation, potentially reducing manufacturing complexity and cost while targeting autoimmune indications (B cell lymphomas, lupus-like conditions) rather than traditional oncology applications.
patents.title_original: MÉDICAMENT, MÉTHODE ET UTILISATION POUR TRAITER DES MALADIES PROVOQUÉES PAR LA PRODUCTION D'AUTOANTICORPS RÉSULTANT D'UNE PROLIFÉRATION EXCESSIVE DE LYMPHOCYTES B

patents.title: AMINO LIPID, AND LIPID NANOPARTICLES AND USE THEREOF
patents.abstract: The present invention provides an amino lipid, and lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) and a use thereof, the amino lipid having a structure represented by general formula (I), or an isomer, pharmaceutically acceptable salt, prodrug or solvate of the amino lipid. The present invention further provides LNPs containing the amino lipid. According to the present invention, the amino lipid having a structure represented by general formula (I) is used as an ionizable lipid compound, and the LNPs are obtained by means of self-assembly of the ionizable lipid compound, a steroid, a neutral lipid, and a polymer-bonded lipid. The LNPs can further improve the translation expression level of a nucleic acid load in cells, improve the effect of a nucleic acid-LNP preparation, and enable the nucleic acid-LNP preparation to provide a theoretical basis for personalized treatment.
patents.assignee: SHENZHEN MAGICRNA BIOTECHNOLOGY CO LTD [CN]; SHENZHEN MAGICRNA BIOTECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
patents.novelty_summary: The invention discloses a novel ionizable amino lipid with improved structure (formula I) and LNPs formulated with this lipid alongside steroid, neutral lipid, and polymer-bonded lipid components. The claimed advantage is enhanced translation/expression of nucleic acid cargo in cells, which is directly relevant for mRNA-based CAR-T therapies where efficient in vivo mRNA delivery and translation are critical for CAR construct expression and therapeutic efficacy.

patents.title: AMINOLIPID, HERSTELLUNGSVERFAHREN UND ANWENDUNG DAVON
patents.abstract: The disclosure belongs to the technical field of medical chemistry, particularly relates to an amino lipid and their preparation method as well as an application thereof, and provides the ionizable amino lipids with a general formula as shown in Formula (I), or pharmaceutically acceptable salts thereof. The amino lipids of the disclosure can be used for delivering nucleic acids and small molecule drugs. The amino lipid compounds have two ester bonds, which obviously enhance the lysosome escape capability of the ionizable amino lipids, and are favorable for the release of delivery targets of a targeted drug or gene, etc., thus improving the delivery efficiency, and showing the good capability of delivering nucleic acids into cells in the in-vitro and in-vivo delivery study.
patents.assignee: SHENZHEN MAGICRNA BIOTECHNOLOGY CO LTD [CN]; Shenzhen MagicRNA Biotechnology Co., Ltd.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent discloses ionizable amino lipids with a specific chemical structure featuring two ester bonds designed to enhance lysosomal escape and nucleic acid delivery efficiency. This represents a structurally distinct approach to lipid nanoparticle formulations with potential competitive advantage in in vivo gene delivery applications, including CAR-T cell engineering where efficient mRNA or DNA delivery is critical.

patents.title: AMINOLIPIDE ET SON APPLICATION
patents.abstract: An amino lipid and an application thereof: using ethenesulfonyl fluoride (ESF), a dual-function electrophile, to build an amine head group and a hydrophobic chain into an amino lipid, fully utilizing the click chemical reaction properties of ESF; in the process of constructing the amino lipid, reaction conditions are mild, protection and deprotection are not needed, and atom economy is high. In vitro and in vivo delivery studies show an excellent ability to deliver nucleic acid into cells. The amino lipid compound is provided with two sulfonamides, and the introduction of the group significantly enhances the stability of lipid nanoparticles and improves the in-vivo cycle time, thereby improving in-vivo delivery efficiency. The preparation method of the amino lipid compound has the advantages of readily available raw materials, mild reaction conditions, good reaction selectivity, high reaction yield, low requirements for instruments and equipment, and simple operations.
patents.assignee: SHENZHEN MAGICRNA BIOTECHNOLOGY CO LTD [CN]; 深圳虹信生物科技有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: Novel amino lipid synthesized via ethenesulfonyl fluoride (ESF) click chemistry with dual sulfonamide groups that enhance lipid nanoparticle stability and in vivo circulation time. The approach demonstrates improved nucleic acid delivery efficiency in vitro and in vivo through optimized ionizable lipid design with high atom economy and simplified synthesis (no protection/deprotection steps).

patents.title: GPR97 targeting small molecule compound and application thereof
patents.abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological medicine, and particularly relates to a GPR97 targeting small molecule compound and application thereof in anti-tumor and anti-inflammatory treatment. The invention provides a class of innovative small molecule compounds targeting GPR97 and application thereof, the structural general formula of the compounds is as shown in formula (I), or tautomers, stereoisomers, hydrates, deuterated compounds, solvates, non-aqueous solvates, pharmaceutically acceptable salts or prodrugs and the like of the compounds, and the compounds have GPR97 regulating activity, can be used for preparing drugs, and can be used for preparing drugs, such as medicines, medicines and the like. The compound is suitable for preventing and/or treating GPR97-mediated diseases, including but not limited to autoimmune diseases, cancers, nervous system diseases and inflammation-related diseases, such as gastric cancer, colorectal cancer and inflammatory bowel diseas
patents.assignee: BIG HEALTH RES INSTITUTE OF HEFEI INTEGRATED SCIENCES CENTER; 合肥综合性国家科学中心大健康研究院
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes novel small molecule compounds with a GPR97-targeting mechanism, potentially useful for modulating immune responses in anti-tumor and anti-inflammatory contexts. GPR97 is an orphan GPCR involved in immune cell regulation; selective modulation could indirectly enhance CAR-T efficacy by creating a permissive tumor microenvironment, though the patent does not explicitly claim direct CAR-T application.

patents.title: CRISPR (clustered regularly interspaced short palindromic repeats) library screening method of lipid metabolism related genes for targeted tumor immunotherapy
patents.abstract: The invention provides a CRISPR (clustered regularly interspaced short palindromic repeats) library screening method of lipid metabolism related genes for targeted tumor therapy. Specifically, the invention develops a lipid metabolism related gene design specific sgRNA for targeted tumor treatment for the first time, and constructs a CRISPR library screening method, so as to realize high-throughput screening of functional genes for targeted tumor treatment.
patents.assignee: BIG HEALTH RES INSTITUTE OF HEFEI INTEGRATED SCIENCES CENTER; 合肥综合性国家科学中心大健康研究院
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes a CRISPR library screening method specifically targeting lipid metabolism-related genes for tumor immunotherapy, claiming to be the first to design sgRNAs for these genes in this context. The competitive significance lies in identifying lipid metabolism regulators as functional targets to enhance anti-tumor immune responses, potentially improving CAR-T cell efficacy by modulating immunosuppressive lipid microenvironments.

patents.title: New tumor immune intervention target SIDT1, inhibitor thereof and application of new tumor immune intervention target SIDT1 in tumor resistance
patents.abstract: According to the invention, a novel immune checkpoint molecule SIDT1 is found. The SIDT1 is a powerful T cell inhibition factor mainly expressed on CD8 < + > T cells. A series of SIDT1 inhibitors are identified in the invention. The SIDT1 inhibitor can enhance the anti-tumor CD8T cell reaction and limit tumor progression, so that a new thought is provided for treatment and prevention of related tumor patients with PD-1 treatment resistance.
patents.assignee: BIG HEALTH RES INSTITUTE OF HEFEI INTEGRATED SCIENCES CENTER; UNIV SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY CHINA; 合肥综合性国家科学中心大健康研究院
patents.novelty_summary: This patent identifies SIDT1 as a novel immune checkpoint molecule expressed on CD8+ T cells and provides inhibitors targeting this checkpoint. The competitive significance lies in offering a potential approach to overcome PD-1 treatment resistance by targeting a distinct T cell inhibitory pathway, which could enhance CAR-T and other adoptive T cell therapies in resistant tumors.

patents.title: CRISPR-Cas12m system and application thereof
patents.abstract: The invention discloses a CRISPR-Cas12m (clustered regularly interspaced short palindromic repeats) system and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of biological medicines. The CRISPR-Cas system is a CRISPR-Cas12m system and comprises a Cas12m polypeptide, and the amino acid sequence of the Cas12m polypeptide is as follows: (1) the amino acid sequence of the Cas12m polypeptide is shown as any one of SEQ ID NO.1-21; and (2) compared with the sequence as shown in SEQ ID NO.1-21, the sequence has 70% of sequence identity. The molecular weight of the Cas12m protein is small, in-vivo delivery is facilitated, and the protein has DNA binding activity and does not have DNA cleavage activity. The protein can be combined with an adenosine deaminase structural domain to form a base editor, and can also be combined with a transcriptional regulation structural domain to form an epigenetic editor.
patents.assignee: BIG HEALTH RES INSTITUTE OF HEFEI INTEGRATED SCIENCES CENTER; 合肥综合性国家科学中心大健康研究院
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes engineered Cas12m variants with small molecular weight optimized for in vivo delivery, particularly a DNA-binding-only variant (lacking cleavage activity) that can be fused with adenosine deaminase for base editing applications. The small protein size and delivery optimization are significant for in vivo CAR-T and T cell engineering applications where packaging constraints limit current CRISPR delivery.

patents.title: CAS9 AND REVERSE TRANSCRIPTASE MUTANTS EXHIBITING IMPROVED ACTIVITY IN PRIME EDITING APPLICATIONS
patents.abstract: This invention pertains to fusion protein mutants comprising a Prime Editing enzyme having a first amino acid sequence and a second amino acid sequence, wherein the first amino acid sequence comprises a SpCas9 H840A nickase mutant protein of SEQ ID NO:152 and the second amino acid sequence comprises a Moloney Murine Leukemia Virus reverse transcriptase protein mutant (MMLV RTase mutant), wherein the fusion protein mutant displays at least the equivalent or greater activity of a reference Prime Editing enzyme in genome editing.
patents.assignee: INTEGRATED DNA TECH INC [US]; INTEGRATED DNA TECHNOLOGIES, INC.
patents.novelty_summary: The invention describes engineered Prime Editing fusion proteins combining SpCas9 H840A nickase mutants with optimized MMLV reverse transcriptase variants, demonstrating enhanced or equivalent genome editing activity. While Prime Editing itself is known, improved enzyme variants with enhanced activity represent incremental advancement relevant to cell engineering applications, though the direct therapeutic significance for in vivo CAR-T deployment remains indirect and dependent on downstream application in T cell modification.
patents.title_original: MUTANTS DE CAS9 ET DE TRANSCRIPTASE INVERSE PRÉSENTANT UNE ACTIVITÉ AMÉLIORÉE DANS DES APPLICATIONS D'ÉDITION PRIMAIRE

patents.title: NOUVELLES TRANSPOSASES ET LEURS UTILISATIONS
patents.abstract: The present invention relates to highly efficient PiggyBac transposases identified through language-model guided correction of genome mined transposons.
patents.assignee: INTEGRA THERAPEUTICS [ES]; INTEGRA THERAPEUTICS
patents.novelty_summary: The invention discloses engineered PiggyBac transposases optimized through computational language-model guided correction of naturally occurring transposons, offering improved efficiency for genomic integration. This is competitively significant for in vivo CAR-T applications as enhanced transposase activity could enable more efficient non-viral delivery and integration of CAR constructs, potentially improving therapeutic efficacy and reducing off-target insertions through better control of integration kinetics.

patents.title: Nucleic acid vectors and methods of use
patents.abstract: The present invention relates to nucleic acid vectors (e.g., circular DNA vectors) and compositions thereof. Also provided are methods of administering nucleic acid vectors (e.g., circular DNA vectors) and compositions thereof, e.g., in combination with pulsed electric field therapy. Also provided are methods and compositions for treating cancer (e.g., cancer characterized by the presence of a solid tumor) by administering a nucleic acid vector carrying a heterologous gene to modulate the tumor microenvironment.
patents.assignee: INTEGRA THERAPEUTICS INC; 英特格拉治疗公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes circular DNA vectors administered in combination with pulsed electric field (PEF) therapy for cancer treatment, with particular application to modulating the tumor microenvironment via heterologous gene delivery. This combination approach—circular DNA vectors with PEF-enhanced delivery—represents a potentially novel administration strategy for in vivo cell reprogramming and immunomodulation, which could be competitive for CAR-T and adoptive cell therapy by enabling direct TME modification without ex vivo cell engineering.

patents.title: USE OF TRANSPOSASES TO IMPROVE TRANSGENIC EXPRESSION AND NUCLEAR LOCALIZATION
patents.abstract: The present invention relates to methods of increasing expression of a transgene of interest in a cell population and/or of increasing nuclear localization of a transgene of interest in a cell population, using a transposase.
patents.assignee: INTEGRA THERAPEUTICS [ES]; UNIV POMPEU FABRA [ES]; INTEGRA THERAPEUTICS
patents.novelty_summary: The invention describes using transposases to enhance transgene expression and nuclear localization in cell populations. This is relevant to CAR-T manufacturing as improved transgene expression and nuclear targeting could increase CAR construct expression efficiency and potentially improve therapeutic potency in engineered T cells.
patents.title_original: UTILISATION DE TRANSPOSASES POUR AMÉLIORER L’EXPRESSION TRANSGÉNIQUE ET LA LOCALISATION NUCLÉAIRE

patents.title: METHOD FOR PRODUCING A LARGE TARGET-SPECIFIC SERINE RECOMBINASE
patents.abstract: The present invention pertains to a method for generating a target-specific large serine recombinase (LSR), the method comprising the steps of: a) generating a plurality of first variants of an LSR by introducing one or more mutations into a sequence encoding the LSR; b) generating a library of expression vectors, wherein each expression vector comprises a first region encoding one of the first variants of an LSR, and a second region comprising at least two first target sites of the LSR, wherein the two first target sites are different from each other; c) introducing the library of expression vectors into host cells; d) culturing the host cells and expressing the first variant LSR; e) isolating plasmid DNA from the culture of host cells; f) determining whether a portion of the second region of the expression vector between the two first target sites has been excised by the variant LSR; g) generating a plurality of second LSR variants by introducing one or more mutations into the sequen
patents.assignee: SEAMLESS THERAPEUTICS GMBH [DE]; SEAMLESS THERAPEUTICS GMBH
patents.novelty_summary: This invention describes a directed evolution method for engineering target-specific large serine recombinases (LSRs) through iterative mutagenesis and selection in host cells. The approach is relevant to in vivo CAR-T as engineered site-specific recombinases enable precise genomic integration of CAR transgenes and controlled transgene expression through inducible systems, potentially improving CAR-T safety and efficacy profiles.
patents.title_original: PROCÉDÉ DE PRODUCTION D'UNE GRANDE RECOMBINASE À SÉRINE SPÉCIFIQUE D'UNE CIBLE

patents.title: Electrotransfection module for organ conformal, bioelectronic patch and preparation method and application of bioelectronic patch
patents.abstract: The invention discloses an electrotransfection module for organ conformal, a bioelectronic patch and a preparation method and application of the bioelectronic patch, an electrotransfection module body is of a paper-cut structure and comprises a substrate layer, an electrode layer, a medicine storage layer and a nanopore layer, and the substrate layer, the electrode layer, the medicine storage layer and the nanopore layer are sequentially stacked together from bottom to top; cutting according to a paper-cut pattern conformal with the target organ to form inlaid paper-cut units connected through hinges; and integrating a wireless communication module to obtain the bioelectronic patch. A paper-cut conformal theory is adopted, a paper-cut structure electrotransfection module and a bioelectronic patch for organ conformal are designed and prepared on the basis of the characteristic slope of a target organ, seamless covering of the target organ is achieved, and meanwhile safe, controllable an
patents.assignee: UNIV BEIHANG; 北京航空航天大学
patents.novelty_summary: The invention presents a novel organ-conformal bioelectronic patch using paper-cut structural design with integrated electrotransfection capability, enabling wireless-controlled localized drug/molecule delivery. While the electrotransfection principle is established, the origami-inspired conformal architecture and integration with wireless communication represents a differentiated approach to localized in vivo delivery, though the patent does not specifically demonstrate CAR-T cell engineering applications.

patents.title: Recombinant chimpanzee oncolytic adenovirus Adsimian-delta24-IL21 as well as construction method and application thereof
patents.abstract: The invention discloses a recombinant chimpanzee oncolytic adenovirus Adsimian-delta24-IL21 and a construction method and application thereof, the vector is based on serotype 25 chimpanzee adenovirus, the immunogenicity is reduced by deleting an E3 region, and the integrin targeting is enhanced by inserting an RGD peptide fragment; a skeleton plasmid pAdsimian-deltaE3 is in seamless cloning connection with a shuttle plasmid pSRK17-delta24-CMV carrying delta24 mutation E1A, a recombinant oncolytic adenovirus Adsimian-delta24-IL21 and a control virus Adsimian-delta24-EGFP are constructed, the delta24 mutation enables the virus specificity to be copied in Rb defect tumor cells, the IL-21 gene remodels a tumor immune microenvironment by activating CD3 +/CD8 + T cells, and the tumor immune microenvironment of the Rb defect tumor cells is improved. The invention provides an efficient carrier and a method for oncolytic-immune combined treatment of colorectal cancer.
patents.assignee: UNIV ZHEJIANG SCIENCE & TECH; ZHEJIANG SCI TECH UNIV SHAOXING ACADEMY OF BIOMEDICINE CO LTD; 浙江理工大学
patents.novelty_summary: The invention combines a chimpanzee adenovirus serotype 25 vector with delta24 E1A mutation (enabling tumor-selective replication in Rb-deficient cells) and IL-21 transgene to create an oncolytic immunotherapy agent that remodels the tumor microenvironment by activating CD8+ T cells. The competitive significance lies in leveraging reduced-immunogenicity chimpanzee adenovirus as a platform for delivering immunostimulatory IL-21 to enhance anti-tumor T cell responses while maintaining selective oncolytic activity.

patents.title: DNA library screening method of intracellular mRNA sensor switch and application
patents.abstract: The invention provides a DNA library screening method and application of an intracellular mRNA sensor switch. The DNA library screening method comprises the following steps: designing a DNA library containing a switch sequence of a degenerate basic group; preparing a circular expression vector library; preparing a minimum linear expression vector library; performing seamless cloning; carrying out RCA rolling circle amplification; carrying out telomerase digestion; carrying out cell transfection; extracting RNA (Ribonucleic Acid) and carrying out reverse transcription; carrying out library building of next-generation sequencing by taking the cDNA as a template; carrying out next-generation sequencing; analyzing data and comparing to obtain the DNA library of the mRNA sensor switch. According to the DNA library screening method provided by the invention, more sensor switch sequences can be provided for a single site on mRNA in cells, and more selection possibilities are further provided
patents.assignee: BEIJING CANCER HOSPITAL BEIJING CANCER HOSPITAL; 北京肿瘤医院（北京大学肿瘤医院）

patents.title: Editing guidance system
patents.abstract: The invention relates to a guided editing system, in particular to pegRNA, a pegRNA combination, a vector for expressing the pegRNA or the pegRNA combination, a vector for expressing PE protein, a tool cell, a guided editing system, a guided editing method, a kit and application of the pegRNA, the pegRNA combination, the vector, the tool cell, the guided editing system, the guided editing method and the kit in preparation of drugs for treating genetic diseases. The pegRNA comprises a first Csy4 endo ribonuclease recognition site and a second Csy4 endo ribonuclease recognition site, and the first Csy4 endo ribonuclease recognition site and the second Csy4 endo ribonuclease recognition site are subjected to enzyme digestion by Csy4 endo ribonuclease. According to the invention, high editing efficiency can be maintained between different target sites and cell types, and large-fragment DNA can be inserted and/or seamless editing can be realized.
patents.assignee: UNIV TSINGHUA; 清华大学
patents.novelty_summary: The invention describes a pegRNA (prime editing guide RNA) with dual Csy4 endonuclease recognition sites that enable post-transcriptional processing to generate mature guide RNAs, improving editing efficiency and specificity in prime editing systems. This represents a technical advancement in prime editing guide RNA design that could enhance precision genome editing applications, including potential use in T cell engineering for CAR-T manufacturing by enabling more efficient and controlled TCR or CAR gene editing.

patents.title: METHOD FOR PRODUCING LEUKOCYTES EXPRESSING CHIMERIC ANTIGEN RECEPTORS
patents.abstract: The present invention relates to a lipid nanoparticle (LNP) suitable for transfecting a leukocyte, which nanoparticle comprises an mRNA encoding for a transposase enzyme, and a DNA encoding for an antigen receptor.
patents.assignee: T CURX GMBH [DE]; T-CURX GMBH
patents.novelty_summary: The invention describes lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) co-delivering mRNA-encoded transposase and DNA-encoded antigen receptors for direct leukocyte transfection. This represents a novel non-viral delivery approach combining transposon-mediated gene integration with LNP formulation, potentially offering advantages over electroporation or viral vectors for CAR-T manufacturing by enabling in situ transduction and integration in primary T cells.
patents.title_original: PROCÉDÉ DE PRODUCTION DE LEUCOCYTES EXPRIMANT DES RÉCEPTEURS D'ANTIGÈNES CHIMÉRIQUES

patents.title: VERBESSERTES TRANSPOSON-SYSTEM ZUR GENVERABREICHUNG
patents.abstract: Described is a transposon system comprising (a) a transposon unit containing inverted terminal repeats (ITRs) or direct terminal repeats (DTRs) that flank a sequence of interest to be inserted into the genome of a target cell; and (b) an RNA encoding a transposase capable of recognizing said ITRs and transposing said sequence of interest into said genome; wherein said RNA encoding said transposase is characterized in that it contains a combination of unmodified and modified nucleotides, wherein 5 to 50% of the uridine nucleotides and 5 to 50% of the cytidine nucleotides are respectively modified uridine nucleotides and modified cytidine nucleotides. Moreover, described is the use of a said transposon system for the ex vivo gene delivery into a target cell. Further, described is an ex vivo method for gene delivery into a target cell comprising the following steps: (a) bringing into contact the transposon system according to any one of claims 1 to 4 with a cell; (b) culturing said cell u
patents.assignee: T CURX GMBH [DE]; T-CURX GmbH
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes an improved transposon system for gene delivery utilizing hybrid modified/unmodified nucleotide RNA encoding transposase (5-50% modified U and C nucleotides), designed to enhance ex vivo gene delivery into target cells. This addresses immunogenicity and stability challenges in non-viral gene transfer, with competitive significance for improving CAR-T manufacturing efficiency and safety by reducing innate immune activation during T cell engineering.

patents.title: ADENOVIRAL VECTORS FOR GENE THERAPY AND THEIR METHODS OF USE
patents.abstract: Among other things, the present disclosure provides adenoviral vectors, genomes, and methods of use thereof. In some embodiments, the present disclosure provides methods of in vivo gene therapy comprising administration of an adenoviral payload vector and an adenoviral integration vector. The present disclosure provides, among other things, compositions comprising an adenoviral payload vector and an adenoviral integration vector for use in, e.g., methods of in vivo gene therapy. In some embodiments, the present disclosure provides adenoviral vectors, genomes, and compositions thereof comprising a therapeutic sequence, e.g., a nucleic acid sequence encoding a CYBB therapeutic polypeptide. In some embodiments, the present disclosure provides methods of treating various conditions, disorders, and diseases, e.g., chronic granulomatous disease.
patents.assignee: ENSOMA INC [US]; ENSOMA, INC.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent discloses a dual adenoviral vector system comprising separate payload and integration vectors for in vivo gene therapy, with specific application to CYBB therapeutic delivery. The competitive significance for in vivo CAR-T is limited as this approach targets integration-based gene correction rather than CAR-T cell engineering; however, the dual-vector integration strategy could be relevant for enhancing T cell transduction efficiency or enabling more complex genetic modifications in adoptive cell therapy contexts.
patents.title_original: VECTEURS ADÉNOVIRAUX DE THÉRAPIE GÉNIQUE ET LEURS MÉTHODES D'UTILISATION

patents.title: CONSTRUCTIONS FOR MULTI-LINEAGE EXPRESSION OF THERAPEUTIC AGENTS
patents.abstract: The present disclosure provides nucleic acid constructs engineered to express therapeutic expression products from regulatory sequences that drive expression in hematopoietic cell populations. For example, the present disclosure includes nucleic acid constructs in which a first regulatory sequence drives expression of a first therapeutic expression product and a second regulatory sequence drives expression of a second therapeutic expression product. Nucleic acid constructs can be delivered to cells or subjects by viral vectors, including adenoviral vectors, e.g., for the treatment of cancer.
patents.assignee: ENSOMA INC [US]; ENSOMA, INC.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes nucleic acid constructs with multiple regulatory sequences driving expression of distinct therapeutic products in hematopoietic cells, delivered via viral vectors (including adenovirals) for cancer treatment. The novelty lies in the engineered multi-lineage expression architecture enabling simultaneous or coordinated therapeutic agent production from a single construct, potentially offering improved efficacy and reduced manufacturing complexity for cell-based cancer therapies.
patents.title_original: CONSTRUCTIONS POUR L'EXPRESSION MULTI-LIGNÉE D'AGENTS THÉRAPEUTIQUES

patents.title: Auxiliary Adenoviral Vectors
patents.abstract: The present disclosure provides, among other things, helper genomes and vectors useful in gene therapy, e.g., for production of helper-dependent donor vectors. Helper genomes of the present disclosure include a conditionally defective packaging sequence.
patents.assignee: ENSOMA INC [US]; ENSOMA, INC.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent discloses helper adenoviral genomes with conditionally defective packaging sequences designed to support production of helper-dependent adenoviral vectors for gene therapy applications. This approach enhances safety and control of helper-dependent vector systems by incorporating conditional defects that limit replication of helper genome itself, which is relevant for in vivo gene delivery but not specifically optimized for CAR-T cell engineering.
patents.title_original: VECTEURS AUXILIAIRES ADÉNOVIRAUX

patents.title: VECTORES AUXILIARES ADENOVIRALES DEL SEROTIPO 35
patents.abstract: La presente divulgación proporciona, entre otras cosas, genomas auxiliares Ad35 y vectores útiles en la terapia génica, por ejemplo, para la producción de vectores donantes Ad35 dependientes de los auxiliares. Los genomas auxiliares de la presente divulgación incluyen una secuencia de empaquetamiento condicionalmente defectuosa.  Reivindicación 1: Un genoma auxiliar adenoviral recombinante que comprende: una repetición de terminal invertida (ITR) Ad35 5; una ITR Ad35 3; y repeticiones directas de recombinasa que flanquean una secuencia de empaquetamiento de Ad35, donde las repeticiones directas de recombinasa comprenden una primera repetición directa de recombinasa entre las posiciones de nucleótidos correspondientes a 155 y 171, 161 y 181, 185 y 205 o 214 y 234 del nº de registro de GenBank AY128640 y una segunda repetición directa de recombinasa entre las posiciones de nucleótidos correspondientes a 377 y 504 o 3175 y 3225 del nº de registro de GenBank AY128640. Reivindicación 16: Un
patents.assignee: ENSOMA INC [US]; ENSOMA, INC.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent discloses Ad35 helper genome vectors with conditionally defective packaging sequences flanked by recombinase-recognizable direct repeats, enabling controlled production of helper-dependent Ad35 vectors for gene therapy applications. This represents a novel approach to engineering safer adenoviral vectors with conditional packaging control, potentially reducing off-target viral production and improving safety profiles for in vivo CAR-T and other cell therapy manufacturing.

patents.title: MGMT MODIFICATIONS RESISTANT TO INHIBITORS AND MODIFICATIONS OF NUCLEIC ACIDS ENCODING MGMT
patents.abstract: The present disclosure includes MGMT modifications that cause MGMT resistance to MGMT inhibitors. The present disclosure also includes in vivo, in vitro, and ex vivo modification of MGMT -encoding nucleic acids to encode and express an MGMT variant that is resistant to MGMT inhibitors. Inhibitor-resistant MGMT modifications and modification of an MGMT- encoding nucleic can occur or be used in conjunction with a therapeutic modification, e.g., in a single cell. Expression of inhibitor-resistant MGMT can selectively protect modified cells from a selection regimen, such as a selection regimen including an MGMT inhibitor and an alkylating agent. Accordingly, in vivo, in vitro, and ex vivo modification of MGMT -encoding nucleic acids can be used in gene therapy to select for modified cells.
patents.assignee: ENSOMA INC [US]; FRED HUTCHINSON CANCER CENTER [US]; ENSOMA, INC.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent discloses MGMT variants engineered to be resistant to MGMT inhibitors, enabling selective expansion of genetically modified cells through pharmacological selection in vivo, in vitro, and ex vivo. This approach is significant for CAR-T and gene therapy as it provides a non-integrating selection mechanism to enrich therapeutic cell populations without requiring marker genes or antibiotic selection, improving safety and manufacturing efficiency.
patents.title_original: MODIFICATIONS DE MGMT RÉSISTANTE AUX INHIBITEURS ET MODIFICATION D'ACIDES NUCLÉIQUES CODANT MGMT

patents.title: ENDONUCLEASE CAS12A VARIANTS AND METHODS OF USE
patents.abstract: The present disclosure provides endonuclease variants having improved properties, such as hyperactivity and/or low indiscriminate single strand DNase activity, relative to the corresponding wild-type endonucleases.
patents.assignee: ENSOMA APS [DK]; ENSOMA APS
patents.novelty_summary: The patent discloses engineered Cas12a endonuclease variants with enhanced hyperactivity and reduced off-target single-strand DNase activity compared to wild-type Cas12a. This is significant for gene therapy and CAR-T applications as improved Cas12a variants could enable more efficient and precise CRISPR-based genome editing with reduced collateral damage during ex vivo T cell engineering.
patents.title_original: VARIANTS D’ENDONUCLÉASE CAS12A ET MÉTHODES D’UTILISATION

patents.title: VECTEURS ADENOVIRAUX DE THERAPIE GENIQUE
patents.abstract: The present disclosure includes adenoviral vectors characterized by efficient transduction of hematopoietic cells (e.g., one or more particular types of hematopoietic cells), e.g., for in vivo or ex vivo gene therapy. The present disclosure includes, among other things, Ad3, Ad5, Ad7, Ad11, Ad14, Ad16, Ad21, Ad34, Ad35, Ad37, and Ad50 vectors and genomes. Ad3, Ad5, Ad7, Ad11, Ad14, Ad16, Ad21, Ad34, Ad35, Ad37, and Ad50 vectors and genomes of the present disclosure can include therapeutic payloads.
patents.assignee: ENSOMA INC [US]; ENSOMA, INC.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent claims engineered adenoviral vectors (Ad3, Ad5, Ad7, Ad11, Ad14, Ad16, Ad21, Ad34, Ad35, Ad37, Ad50) optimized for efficient transduction of hematopoietic cells in both in vivo and ex vivo gene therapy applications, with capacity to carry therapeutic payloads. This is competitively significant for CAR-T delivery as it addresses the challenge of efficient in vivo transduction of T cells and related hematopoietic cells, potentially enabling direct in vivo CAR-T engineering as an alternative to ex vivo manufacturing.

patents.title: MODIFICATION OF NUCLEIC ACIDS ENCODING EPOR
patents.abstract: Gene therapy typically modifies some, but not all, cells of a population of target cells. One approach to increasing the prevalence of modified cells includes delivering to the modified cells a gene that provides a competitive advantage (e.g., a proliferative advantage) and therefore results in enrichment of modified cells. The present disclosure including, among other things, methods and compositions for providing a competitive advantage to one or more cells by providing to the cells a nucleic acid encoding a signaling-enhanced EpoR polypeptide (e.g., a truncated EpoR or gain-of-function EpoR).
patents.assignee: ENSOMA INC [US]; ENSOMA, INC.
patents.novelty_summary: The invention provides nucleic acids encoding signaling-enhanced EpoR polypeptides (truncated or gain-of-function variants) to confer proliferative advantage to modified cells, enabling enrichment of gene-modified cell populations without requiring external cytokine stimulation. This is particularly significant for CAR-T and other cell therapies where achieving high frequencies of desired modifications is critical for clinical efficacy, offering an alternative to conventional selection or expansion strategies.
patents.title_original: MODIFICATION D'ACIDES NUCLÉIQUES CODANT POUR EPOR

patents.title: VECTEURS ADENOVIRAUX DE THERAPIE GENIQUE
patents.abstract:
[0001]    The present disclosure includes adenoviral vectors characterized by efficient transduction of HSCs, e.g., for in vivo gene therapy. The present disclosure includes, among other things, Ad3, Ad7, Ad11, Ad14, Ad16, Ad21, Ad34, Ad37, and Ad50 vectors and genomes. Ad3, Ad7, Ad11, Ad14, Ad16, Ad21, Ad34, Ad37, and Ad50 vectors and genomes of the present disclosure can include therapeutic payloads.

Les vecteurs et génomes Ad3, Ad7, Ad11, Ad 14, Ad 16, Ad21, Ad34, Ad37, et Ad50 de la présente invention peuvent comprendre des charges thérapeutiques.
patents.assignee: ENSOMA INC [US]; ENSOMA, INC.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent discloses adenoviral vectors (Ad3, Ad7, Ad11, Ad14, Ad16, Ad21, Ad34, Ad37, Ad50) engineered for efficient transduction of hematopoietic stem cells (HSCs) in in vivo gene therapy applications. The competitive significance lies in providing alternative serotype vectors with improved HSC tropism and transduction efficiency compared to conventional vectors, potentially enabling broader therapeutic payload delivery for blood-based genetic diseases.

patents.title: VECTEURS ADENOVIRAUX DE SEROTYPE 35 AUXILIAIRES
patents.abstract: The present disclosure provides, among other things, Ad35 helper genomes and vectors useful in gene therapy, e.g., for production of helper-dependent Ad35 donor vectors. Helper genomes of the present disclosure include a conditionally defective packaging sequence.
patents.assignee: ENSOMA INC [US]; ENSOMA, INC.
patents.novelty_summary: This patent discloses Ad35 (adenovirus serotype 35) helper genomes with conditionally defective packaging sequences for use in producing helper-dependent adenoviral vectors. The conditional defectivity mechanism enables safer, more controlled manufacturing of helper-dependent Ad35 vectors for gene therapy applications, potentially providing improved safety profiles for in vivo CAR-T delivery compared to earlier adenoviral vector systems.

patents.title: Methods and compositions for transducing hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells in vivo
patents.abstract: The invention relates to the
patents.assignee: ENSOMA INC [US]; UNIV OF WASHINGTON [US]; ENSOMA, INC.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes in vivo transduction methods and compositions for hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells (HSPCs), enabling direct genetic modification without ex vivo cell manipulation. This is significant for CAR-T and gene therapy as it potentially eliminates the need for cell extraction, ex vivo engineering, and reinfusion, reducing manufacturing complexity and cost while maintaining therapeutic efficacy through in vivo gene delivery.

patents.title: DOSING REGIMENS FOR THE MOBILIZATION OF HEMATOPOIETIC STEM AND PROGENITOR CELLS

patents.title: METHODS AND COMPOSITIONS FOR MODULATING CAR-T ACTIVITY
patents.abstract: [0001]    Disclosed herein are engineered cells and/or hypoimmunogenic cells including engineered and/or hypoimmunogenic stem cells, engineered and/or hypoimmunogenic cells differentiated therefrom, engineered and/or hypoimmunogenic CAR-T cells (primary or differentiated from engineered and/or hypoimmunogenic stem cells) and related methods of their use and generation. patents.novelty_summary: The patent presents engineered hypoimmunogenic CAR-T cells with reduced MHC class I/II and TCR expression combined with exogenous expression of tolerogenic factors (e.g., CD47) and CARs. This addresses a key limitation in allogeneic CAR-T therapy—immune rejection and graft-versus-host disease—by creating 'off-the-shelf' universal donor cells with enhanced persistence and reduced immunogenicity, offering significant competitive advantage for allogeneic in vivo CAR-T applications.

patents.title: METHODES DE DECLENCHEMENT DE MECANISMES DE DESTRUCTION DE SECURITE AU MOYEN D'UN AGENT DE BLOCAGE CD47-SIRP.ALPHA.
patents.abstract: [0001]    The present disclosure provides methods and compositions for administering to a subject in need thereof a CD47-SIRP blockade agent, wherein the subject was previously administered a population of cells engineered to express an exogenous CD47 polypeptide.

patents.title: METHODS OF TREATING SENSITIZED PATIENTS WITH HYPOIMMUNOGENIC CELLS, AND ASSOCIATED METHODS AND COMPOSITIONS

In some embodiments, circular RNA of the invention has improved expression, functional stability, immunogenicity, ease of manufacturing, and/or half-life when compared to linear RNA. In some embodiments, inventive methods and constructs result in improved circularization efficiency, splicing efficiency, and/or purity when compared to existing RNA circularization approaches.
patents.assignee: ORNA THERAPEUTICS INC [US]; ORNA THERAPEUTICS, INC.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes engineered circular RNA (circRNA) constructs incorporating group I self-splicing introns, multiple expression sequences, and optimized structural elements (spacers, IRES, cleavage sites) that achieve improved expression, stability, immunogenicity profile, and manufacturing efficiency compared to linear RNA. For in vivo CAR-T applications, circRNA delivery offers potential advantages in transient transgene expression, reduced innate immune activation, and simplified manufacturing—positioning ORNA's approach as a competitive alternative to viral vectors and DNA/linear RNA platforms for therapeutic T cell engineering.

patents.assignee: ORICELL THERAPEUTICS CO LTD [CN]; Oricell Therapeutics Co., Ltd.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent discloses engineered immune cells (CAR-T or TCR-T cells) with enhanced leptin signaling through overexpression of leptin receptors and/or co-expression of leptin, representing a novel metabolic engineering approach to improve T cell persistence and anti-tumor function. The integration of leptin pathway modulation with CAR-T/TCR-T technology addresses a clinically relevant mechanism for enhancing in vivo CAR-T cell performance through improved metabolic fitness and survival.

patents.title: ANTI-PD-L1 ANTIBODY AND USE THEREOF
patents.abstract: An antibody that binds to the PD-L1 protein or CD137 protein, an antigen-binding fragment or a variant thereof, as well as a bispecific antibody that can bind to both the PD-L1 protein and the CD137 protein. The bispecific antibody has a strong ability to specifically recognize the PD-L1 protein and the CD137 protein, and can enhance T-cell activity. The antibody or the antigen-binding fragment or the variant thereof and the bispecific antibody may be used in the prevention and treatment of tumors.
patents.assignee: ORIGINCELL THERAPEUTICS CO LTD [CN]; ORICELL THERAPEUTICS CO LTD [CN]; ORIGINCELL THERAPEUTICS CO., LTD.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes bispecific antibodies that simultaneously bind PD-L1 and CD137, enabling dual checkpoint modulation and T-cell co-stimulation in a single molecule. This approach offers competitive advantage by combining immune checkpoint blockade with direct T-cell activation, potentially enhancing anti-tumor efficacy compared to monoclonal antibodies alone.

patents.title: METHOD FOR PROMOTING IMMUNE CELL PROLIFERATION
patents.abstract: Disclosed is a method for promoting immune cell proliferation. The method comprises the following step: upregulating the expression of low-density lipoprotein receptor-related proteins or fragments thereof in immune cells.
patents.assignee: ORIGINCELL THERAPEUTICS CO LTD [CN]; ORICELL THERAPEUTICS CO LTD [CN]; ORIGINCELL THERAPEUTICS CO., LTD.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent discloses upregulation of low-density lipoprotein receptor-related proteins (LDL receptor family members) as a method to promote immune cell proliferation. This approach could be significant for CAR-T cell manufacturing by enhancing ex vivo expansion efficiency, potentially reducing production time and cost while improving therapeutic cell yields for infusion.

patents.title: Fully human antibody targeting BAFF-R
patents.abstract: The invention provides a fully humanized antibody or a single-chain antibody or a fragment thereof targeting BAFF-R, the fully humanized antibody or the single-chain antibody or the fragment thereof is combined with BAFF-R with high affinity and high specificity, and compared with a heterologous antibody, the fully humanized antibody or the single-chain antibody or the fragment thereof has lower immunogenicity and has good application potential in development of antibody drugs (including monoclonal antibodies, double antibodies, antibody coupling drugs (ADC) and the like) and cell therapy drugs (including CAR-T, CAR-NK and the like).
patents.assignee: NANJING IASO BIO TECH CO LTD; NANJING IASO BIOPHARMACEUTICAL CO LTD; 南京驯鹿生物技术股份有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent discloses fully humanized antibodies and single-chain antibody fragments targeting BAFF-R with high affinity and specificity, offering reduced immunogenicity compared to heterologous antibodies. The competitive significance lies in enabling CAR-T/CAR-NK engineering platforms that leverage BAFF-R targeting for potential immunomodulation, though the patent does not detail specific in vivo CAR-T mechanisms or comparative efficacy data.

patents.title: Bispecific CAR-T cell targeting BCMA and GPRC5D
patents.abstract: The present invention provides a bispecific CAR-T cell that targets BCMA and GPRC5D, and a method for preparing the bispecific CAR-T cell. Specifically, the invention provides an autologous CAR-T cell which simultaneously aims at BCMA and GPRC5D antigen molecules and expresses a chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) in parallel. The invention also provides application of the CAR-T cell in adoptive T cell therapy of diseases such as multiple myeloma.
patents.assignee: NANJING IASO BIO TECH CO LTD; SHANGHAI XUNLU BIO TECH CO LTD; 南京驯鹿生物技术股份有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The invention presents a bispecific CAR-T cell simultaneously targeting both BCMA and GPRC5D antigens, two validated multiple myeloma-associated antigens, with a manufacturing method for autologous cell preparation. This dual-targeting approach offers potential competitive advantages over monospecific CAR-T therapies by broadening tumor cell recognition and potentially reducing antigen escape mechanisms in multiple myeloma treatment.

patents.title: Chimeric antigen receptor immune cells targeting BAFF-R and CD19
patents.abstract: The invention provides a chimeric antigen receptor immune cell targeting BAFF-R and CD19, and a preparation method of the chimeric antigen receptor immune cell. The invention provides bispecific CAR-T cells with series and parallel structures, and the bispecific CAR-T cells have obvious killing ability on target cells expressing BAFF-R and/or CD19. The CAR-T cell provided by the invention makes up the problem of target loss possibly caused by single-target CAR, is expected to achieve a better curative effect on CD19 negative or recurrent B cell lymphoma patients, covers a wider patient group, and has application prospects in the field of tumor treatment.
patents.assignee: NANJING IASO BIO TECH CO LTD; NANJING IASO BIOPHARMACEUTICAL CO LTD; 南京驯鹿生物技术股份有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The invention presents bispecific CAR-T cells with dual targeting of BAFF-R and CD19 in both series and parallel configurations, designed to overcome antigen escape and target loss encountered with single-target CAR-T approaches. This dual-targeting strategy expands therapeutic applicability to CD19-negative or relapsed B-cell lymphoma patients, representing a clinically relevant advancement for difficult-to-treat patient populations.

patents.title: Completely human antibody targeting CD33
patents.abstract: The invention provides a fully humanized antibody targeting CD33 and an application of the fully humanized antibody. Specifically, the invention provides a CD33 targeting antibody with a brand new sequence, a chimeric antigen receptor constructed based on the antibody or an antigen binding fragment thereof, and an immune cell for expressing the chimeric antigen receptor. The antibody can be highly specifically combined with a CD33 antigen, has very high affinity and remarkable anti-tumor activity, and can be used for preparing medicines for treating diseases related to CD33.
patents.assignee: NANJING IASO BIO TECH CO LTD; 南京驯鹿生物技术股份有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent discloses a fully humanized CD33-targeting antibody with a novel sequence, a CAR construct derived from this antibody, and immune cells engineered to express the CAR. The competitive significance lies in providing a new CD33-targeting modality with claimed high affinity and specificity for treating CD33-related malignancies, particularly relevant for CD33+ hematologic cancers in the CAR-T space.

patents.title: Fully humanized antibody targeting BAFF-R and application thereof in CAR-T treatment
patents.abstract: The invention provides a fully humanized antibody targeting BAFF-R and an application of the fully humanized antibody in CAR-T (Chimeric Antigen Receptor-T) treatment. According to the present invention, the BAFF-R targeting completely human antibody or the antigen binding fragment thereof is obtained through screening of the completely human phage library, and is specifically bound with BAFF-R with high affinity; based on the screened antibody sequence, the invention provides a fully human chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) targeting BAFF-R and a host cell expressing the CAR, such as a CAR-T cell, and provides application of the CAR and the CAR-T cell in the aspect of B cell tumor treatment.
patents.assignee: NANJING IASO BIO TECH CO LTD; NANJING IASO BIOPHARMACEUTICAL CO LTD; 南京驯鹿生物技术股份有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent presents a fully humanized anti-BAFF-R antibody derived from phage display library screening with claimed high-affinity binding, which is novel repurposed as the antigen recognition domain for a CAR-T cell construct targeting B cell malignancies. The competitive significance lies in addressing immunogenicity concerns through complete humanization and potentially expanding CAR-T applicability to BAFF-R+ B cell tumors, a target not as widely exploited as CD19 or BCMA in the CAR-T landscape.

patents.title: Fully Human Antibody and CAR-T Cell Targeting BAFF-R and Its Use
