patents.abstract: A fully human single-domain antibody, a monoclonal antibody, a bispecific antibody, and a CAR-T cell targeting BAFF-R and a use thereof. Provided are a fully human antibody or antigen-binding fragment thereof targeting BAFF-R and obtained by means of screening a fully human phage library, a fully human chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) targeting BAFF-R, and an immune cell expressing the CAR. Further provided is a bispecific antibody targeting BAFF-R and CD3 in different combination configurations. Further provided is a use of the foregoing antibodies and the CAR-immune cell in the treatment of B cell tumors.
patents.assignee: NANJING IASO BIOTECHNOLOGY CO LTD [CN]; NANJING IASO MEDICAL TECH CO LTD [CN]; 南京驯鹿生物技术股份有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent presents fully human anti-BAFF-R antibodies derived from phage display library screening, CAR-T cells engineered to target BAFF-R, and bispecific antibodies targeting BAFF-R/CD3 for B cell malignancy treatment. The competitive significance lies in BAFF-R as a novel CAR-T target for B cell tumors, offering potential advantages over conventional CD19/CD20-targeting approaches, particularly for BAFF-R-expressing lymphomas and potentially overcoming some resistance mechanisms in B cell cancers.
patents.title_original: ANTICORPS ENTIÈREMENT HUMAIN ET CELLULE CAR-T CIBLANT BAFF-R ET SON UTILISATION

patents.title: Preparation and application of targeted BAFF-R and CD3 bispecific antibody
patents.abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of biology, in particular to an anti-BAFF-R and anti-CD3 bispecific antibody and application thereof. The bispecific antibody disclosed by the invention can be specifically combined with a cell surface B cell activating factor receptor (BAFF-R) and an immune cell surface antigen molecular cluster 3 (CD3); wherein the anti-BAFF-R antibody is a full human source single domain antibody. The invention also provides a preparation method of the bispecific antibody with different combination configurations of 1 + 1, 2 + 1 and 2 + 2 and an in-vitro and in-vivo biological activity evaluation method. The bispecific antibody disclosed by the invention has relatively high affinity and can be used for treating BAFFR expressed tumor diseases and autoimmune diseases.
patents.assignee: NANJING IASO BIO TECH CO LTD; NANJING IASO BIOPHARMACEUTICAL CO LTD; 南京驯鹿生物技术股份有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent discloses a BAFF-R/CD3 bispecific antibody constructed from fully human single-domain antibodies in multiple configural formats (1+1, 2+1, 2+2) with claimed high affinity for dual tumor and autoimmune targeting. While bispecific antibody platforms are well-established, the specific BAFF-R/CD3 combination and full human single-domain architecture may offer differentiated engagement of B cell malignancies; however, competitive advantage over existing CD3-engaging bispecifics (which dominate the in vivo CAR-T adjacent space) is unclear from the abstract alone.

patents.title: Completely humanized antibody targeting CD22 and application thereof
patents.abstract: The invention relates to the field of antibodies, and provides a fully humanized antibody targeting CD22 and application thereof. The invention provides an anti-CD22 fully humanized single-domain antibody, which is combined with CD22 with high affinity and high specificity, has lower immunogenicity and side effect, and has good application potential in development of medicines for treating diseases related to CD22.
patents.assignee: SHANGHAI XUNLU BIO TECH CO LTD; NANJING IASO BIO TECH CO LTD; 上海驯鹿生物技术有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes a fully humanized single-domain antibody (sdAb) targeting CD22 with claimed high affinity and specificity, designed to minimize immunogenicity and adverse effects. While CD22-targeting antibodies exist in clinical practice, a fully humanized single-domain format may offer advantages in CAR-T engineering through reduced size for construct optimization and improved manufacturing, though the patent lacks specific disclosure of CAR-T applications.

patents.title: Antibody targeting BCMA and application thereof
patents.abstract: The present application provides an antibody that targets BCMA. The invention also provides different forms of recombinant receptor molecules constructed through the antigen binding domain of the antibody, and nucleic acid molecules and expression vectors encoding the antibody and the recombinant receptor molecules. The present application also relates to the use of said antibodies, including recombinant receptors of CAR molecules, in the treatment of disease, in particular in the treatment of multiple bone marrow cancer.
patents.assignee: NANJING IASO BIO TECH CO LTD; 南京驯鹿生物技术股份有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes anti-BCMA antibodies and their conversion into recombinant receptor molecules, including CAR constructs, for treating multiple myeloma and related bone marrow cancers. The competitive significance lies in providing alternative BCMA-targeting CAR-T approaches, though BCMA is an established target with existing approved therapies (idecabtagene vicleucel, teclistamab), making incremental novelty dependent on specific binding characteristics or functional improvements over known anti-BCMA agents.

patents.title: Chimeric molecule receptor of dual-targeting BCMA/GPRC5D and application thereof
patents.abstract: The invention provides a bispecific antibody and a chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) which are targeted to BCMA and GPRC5D. The invention also provides a nucleic acid molecule for coding the bispecific antibody and the chimeric antigen receptor, an expression vector containing the nucleic acid molecule, and a cell for expressing the bispecific antibody and the chimeric antigen receptor. The invention also relates to application of the bispecific antibody and the chimeric antigen receptor in disease treatment, in particular to application in treatment of multiple bone marrow cancer.
patents.assignee: NANJING IASO BIO TECH CO LTD; 南京驯鹿生物技术股份有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent discloses a bispecific CAR construct with dual targeting capability against BCMA and GPRC5D, enabling simultaneous engagement of two distinct tumor-associated antigens expressed on multiple myeloma cells. This dual-targeting approach offers potential advantages in reducing antigen escape and improving therapeutic efficacy compared to single-target CAR-T therapies.

patents.title: CELLULE CAR-T UNIVERSELLE CIBLANT CD5 ET CD7 ET SON UTILISATION
patents.abstract: Provided herein is a method for preparing a universal chimeric antigen receptor T (UCAR-T) cell, comprising: knocking out genes such as TRAC, B2M, CD5 and CD7 in a T cell, and transfecting the T cell to enable the expression of a chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) targeting a tumor cell. Also provided herein is a preferred sgRNA for gene knockout. The UCAR-T cell provided herein can be used for treating cancers.
patents.assignee: SHANGHAI IASO BIOTECHNOLOGY CO LTD [CN]; 上海驯鹿生物技术有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes universal CAR-T cells generated by knocking out TRAC, B2M, CD5, and CD7 genes combined with CAR expression targeting tumor cells. The novelty lies in the specific multi-gene knockout strategy (particularly dual knockout of CD5 and CD7 alongside TRAC and B2M) to create allogeneic CAR-T cells with reduced immunogenicity and potential for off-the-shelf therapeutic application, representing a competitive approach to next-generation universal CAR-T manufacturing.

patents.title: Cell Expressing a Chimeric Antigen Receptor (CAR) Targeting CD5 and Its Use
patents.abstract: A chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) specifically binding to a CD5 protein, comprising a CD5 binding domain, a transmembrane domain, a co-stimulatory domain, and an intracellular signaling domain. Further provided is an engineered immune effector cell (such as a T cell) comprising the CAR. Further provided is a use of the CAR and the engineered immune effector cell in the treatment of diseases or symptoms related to expression of CD5.
patents.assignee: SHANGHAI IASO BIOTECHNOLOGY CO LTD [CN]; 上海驯鹿生物技术有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: This patent claims a CD5-targeting CAR with standard modular architecture (binding domain, transmembrane, co-stimulatory, and intracellular signaling domains) and its use in engineered T cells for CD5+ diseases. The novelty is limited given the maturity of CAR-T platform technology; competitive significance depends on specific binding domain optimization and performance data against CD5+ malignancies (T-cell lymphomas, CLL), which are not detailed in the abstract.
patents.title_original: CELLULE EXPRIMANT UN RÉCEPTEUR ANTIGÉNIQUE CHIMÉRIQUE (CAR) CIBLANT CD5 ET SON UTILISATION

patents.title: Antibody targeting GPRC5D and application thereof
patents.abstract: The invention provides a GPRC5D-targeted antibody and application thereof, the GPRC5D-targeted antibody comprises a heavy chain variable region and a light chain variable region, the amino acid sequence of LCDR1 is ENIYSY, and the amino acid sequence of LCDR2 is NAK; the amino acid sequence of the LCDR3 is QHHYGTPYT, the amino acid sequence of the HCDR1 is GFTFSSYG, the amino acid sequence of the HCDR2 is ISNRGTYI, the amino acid sequence of the HCDR3 is ARPRQIGIFDY, or the amino acid sequence of the LCDR1 is QSLNSGNQKNY, and the amino acid sequence of the LCDR2 is GAS; the amino acid sequence of the LCDR3 is QQHYSTPYT, the amino acid sequence of the HCDR1 is GFTFSSYG, the amino acid sequence of the HCDR2 is ISNRGTYI, and the amino acid sequence of the HCDR3 is ARPRQIGIFDY.
patents.assignee: NANJING IASO BIO TECH CO LTD; NANJING IASO BIOPHARMACEUTICAL CO LTD; 南京驯鹿生物技术股份有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes novel monoclonal antibodies with specific CDR sequences targeting GPRC5D, a surface antigen expressed on multiple myeloma and other hematologic malignancies. GPRC5D-targeted antibodies are clinically significant for CAR-T cell engineering as they enable alternative tumor recognition mechanisms beyond conventional targets (CD19, BCMA), potentially addressing antigen escape and expanding addressable patient populations in multiple myeloma.

patents.title: Fully Humanized Chimeric Antigen Receptor (CAR) Targeting GPRC5D and Its Use
patents.abstract: Provided herein is a GPRC5D-targeting fully humanized chimeric antigen receptor (CAR). Further provided herein is a host cell expressing the CAR, such as a CAR-T cell. Also provided herein is the use of the CAR and the CAR-T cell in the treatment of tumors (e.g. multiple myeloma).
patents.assignee: SHANGHAI IASO BIOTECHNOLOGY CO LTD [CN]; 上海驯鹿生物技术有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes a fully humanized GPRC5D-targeting CAR with reduced immunogenicity compared to chimeric or partially humanized versions, and its application in CAR-T cells for multiple myeloma treatment. The competitive significance lies in the potential for improved tolerability and repeated dosing capability in solid tumors and hematologic malignancies expressing GPRC5D.
patents.title_original: RÉCEPTEUR ANTIGÉNIQUE CHIMÉRIQUE (CAR) ENTIÈREMENT HUMANISÉ CIBLANT GPRC5D ET SON UTILISATION

patents.title: GDF15 targeting fully humanized antibody and application thereof
patents.abstract: The invention provides a fully humanized antibody targeting GDF15 and application thereof, the fully humanized antibody targeting GDF15 comprises a heavy chain variable region and a light chain variable region, the heavy chain variable region comprises HCDR1 as shown in SEQ ID NO.1, HCDR2 as shown in SEQ ID NO.2 and HCDR3 as shown in SEQ ID NO.3, the light chain variable region comprises LCDR1 and LCDR2 as shown in SEQ ID NO.4 and LCDR3 as shown in SEQ ID NO.5, and the amino acid sequence of the LCDR2 is INN. According to the present invention, the GDF15 targeting completely humanized antibody specifically binds to GDF15 with high affinity, can block the binding of GDF15 and its receptor GPRAL, and has characteristics of low immunogenicity and good application potential in the development of antibody drugs compared with the heterologous antibody.
patents.assignee: SHANGHAI IASO BIOTECH CO LTD; 上海驯鹿生物技术有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes a fully humanized anti-GDF15 monoclonal antibody with defined CDR sequences that blocks GDF15-GPRAL interaction. While GDF15 targeting has potential in cancer immunotherapy contexts (particularly relevant to CAR-T toxicity mitigation, as GDF15 elevation correlates with cytokine release syndrome), the patent focuses narrowly on antibody composition without explicit CAR-T application or mechanistic integration with cell therapy.

patents.title: Fully Human Antibody Targeting GPRC5D
patents.abstract: Provided is a fully human antibody targeting GPRC5D, or an antigen-binding fragment thereof, comprising a fully human antibody, which specifically binds to GPRC5D with a high affinity. Further provided are a fusion protein, bispecific antibody and immunoconjugate comprising the fully human antibody targeting GPRC5D, or the antigen-binding fragment thereof, and the use thereof in detection and treatment.
patents.assignee: SHANGHAI IASO BIOTECHNOLOGY CO LTD [CN]; 上海驯鹿生物技术有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes fully human antibodies targeting GPRC5D with high affinity, including fusion proteins, bispecific antibodies, and immunoconjugates. This is relevant to CAR-T therapy as GPRC5D-targeting constructs (particularly bispecific antibodies) can serve as bridging molecules for dual-antigen CAR-T approaches or as standalone therapeutic agents for multiple myeloma and related hematologic malignancies.
patents.title_original: ANTICORPS ENTIÈREMENT HUMAIN CIBLANT GPRC5D

patents.title: ANTICORPS ENTIEREMENT HUMAIN CIBLANT GPRC5D ET RECEPTEUR ANTIGENIQUE CHIMERIQUE (CAR) ET SON UTILISATION
patents.abstract: A fully human antibody targeting GPRC5D and a chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) comprising the fully human antibody. A host cell expressing the CAR, such as a CAR-T cell. A use of the fully human antibody, the CAR, and the CAR-T cell in treatment of tumors (such as multiple myeloma).
patents.assignee: SHANGHAI IASO BIOTECHNOLOGY CO LTD [CN]; SHANGHAI IASO BIOTECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes a fully human antibody targeting GPRC5D integrated into a chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) construct, with application to CAR-T cells for tumor treatment, particularly multiple myeloma. The competitive significance lies in using a fully human antibody (reducing immunogenicity) as the targeting domain in CAR-T therapy against GPRC5D, an emerging target in hematologic malignancies, potentially offering improved tolerability and persistence compared to murine or humanized alternatives.

patents.title: Immune cell for killing escape allosome NK cells and application thereof
patents.abstract: The invention provides an immune cell for killing an escape allosome NK cell and application of the immune cell. The function of a CD58 gene of the immune cell is inhibited. According to the invention, a series of researches are carried out on the CD58 gene, and attack and killing of universal CAR-T escape host NK and T cells are realized through knockout modification of CD58. The universal CAR-T cell designed by the invention can effectively escape from killing of allosome NK cells, and a brand new strategy for killing of the universal CAR-T cell escaping from host NK cells is provided.
patents.assignee: SHANGHAI IASO BIOTECH CO LTD; 上海驯鹿生物技术有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes immune cells (specifically universal CAR-T cells) with inhibited CD58 gene function to evade killing by allogeneic host NK cells. The novelty lies in using CD58 knockout modification to enable CAR-T cells to escape NK cell-mediated cytotoxicity while maintaining anti-tumor function, addressing a key challenge in allogeneic CAR-T cell therapy where host immune rejection limits therapeutic efficacy.

patents.title: Fully humanized antibody, single-chain antibody and antigen binding fragment of targeted BAFF-R antigen
patents.abstract: The invention provides a fully humanized antibody, a single-chain antibody and an antigen binding fragment of a targeted BAFF-R antigen, the fully humanized antibody, the single-chain antibody and the antigen binding fragment of the targeted BAFF-R antigen are combined with the BAFF-R antigen with high affinity and high specificity, and compared with a heterologous antibody, the fully humanized antibody, the single-chain antibody and the antigen binding fragment have lower immunogenicity and can be used for preparing the BAFF-R antigen. The method has good application potential in development of antibody drugs and cell therapy drugs.
patents.assignee: NANJING IASO BIOTHERAPEUTICS TECH CO LTD; 南京驯鹿医疗技术有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes fully humanized antibodies, single-chain antibodies, and antigen binding fragments targeting BAFF-R with claimed high affinity, high specificity, and reduced immunogenicity compared to heterologous antibodies. The competitive significance for in vivo CAR-T is limited but relevant for combination approaches, as BAFF-R targeting could modulate B cell survival in tumor microenvironments or reduce anti-drug antibody responses against CAR-T constructs.

patents.title: Completely humanized antibody targeting CD7 and application thereof
patents.abstract: The invention provides a fully humanized antibody targeting CD7 and application of the fully humanized antibody. The CD7-targeted fully humanized antibody is specifically combined with CD7 with high affinity, and compared with a heterologous antibody, the CD7-targeted fully humanized antibody has lower immunogenicity and has good application potential in development of antibody drugs including monoclonal antibodies, double antibodies, antibody coupling drugs and the like and cell therapy drugs including CAR-T, CAR-NK and the like.
patents.assignee: SHANGHAI IASO BIOTECH CO LTD; 上海驯鹿生物技术有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: A fully humanized anti-CD7 antibody with high affinity binding and reduced immunogenicity compared to chimeric/heterologous counterparts. Significant for CAR-T engineering as CD7 is an emerging target for T-cell malignancies, and the humanized antibody enables both direct therapeutic application and incorporation into CAR-T constructs with improved safety profiles.

patents.title: APPLICATION OF CAR-T BCMA IN THE PREPARATION OF A MEDICAMENT FOR THE TREATMENT OF AUTOIMMUNE DISEASES
patents.abstract: Provided is an application of an immune effector cell in the preparation of a drug for preventing and/or treating autoimmune diseases. The immune effector cell comprises a chimeric antigen receptor (CAR), wherein the CAR comprises an antigen binding domain targeting BCMA, a transmembrane domain, a costimulatory domain, and an intracellular signaling domain, wherein the antigen binding domain is a fully human antigen binding domain.
patents.assignee: NANJING IASO BIOTHERAPEUTICS CO LTD [CN]; 南京驯鹿医疗技术有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent claims a novel application of BCMA-targeting CAR-T cells for treating autoimmune diseases (rather than hematologic malignancies where BCMA-CAR-T is established), utilizing fully human antigen binding domains to minimize immunogenicity. This represents a therapeutic indication shift for a known CAR construct, potentially expanding addressable market and reducing risks of xenogeneic immune responses in chronic autoimmune contexts.
patents.title_original: APPLICATION DE CAR-T BCMA DANS LA PRÉPARATION D'UN MÉDICAMENT POUR LE TRAITEMENT DE MALADIES AUTO-IMMUNES

patents.title: Fully Humanized Chimeric Antigen Receptor (CAR) for Dual CD5 and CD7 Targets and Its Use
patents.abstract: A CAR targeting CD5 and/or CD7, a host cell expressing the CAR targeting CD5 and/or CD7, and a preparation method therefor and the use thereof in treating T-cell-related tumors.
patents.assignee: SHANGHAI IASO BIOTECHNOLOGY CO LTD [CN]; 上海驯鹿生物技术有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes a fully humanized CAR targeting dual antigens CD5 and/or CD7 with engineered host cells expressing this CAR, designed for treating T-cell malignancies. The dual-targeting approach and complete humanization represent a competitive advancement for addressing on-target/off-tumor toxicity concerns in CAR-T therapy against T-cell lymphomas and leukemias.
patents.title_original: RÉCEPTEUR ANTIGÉNIQUE CHIMÉRIQUE ENTIÈREMENT HUMANISÉ (CAR) POUR CIBLES DOUBLES CD5 ET CD7 ET SON UTILISATION

patents.title: PREPARATION FOR IMPROVED CHIMERIC ANTIGEN RECEPTOR (CAR) CELLS AND THEIR USE
patents.abstract: Provided is an immune cell capable of expressing multiple components. The immune cell comprises two types of chimeric antigen receptors. The first type of chimeric antigen receptor can enhance the proliferation or activity of immune cells. The immune cell can also express competitive receptors with a missing function such as dNTGF-βRII, can solve the problem of immunosuppressive microenvironments existing in solid tumor tissues, and has a greatly improved ability to kill solid tumors. Meanwhile, the immune cell also expresses a tEGFR molecule, CAR-T cells in vivo can be effectively removed by means of injecting an antibody for EGFR, and a security risk caused by the CAR-T cells is safeguarded against.
patents.assignee: NANJING IASO BIOTHERAPEUTICS CO LTD [CN]; 南京驯鹿医疗技术有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes dual CAR-T cells engineered with two types of CARs—one enhancing proliferation/activity and another incorporating a dominant-negative TGF-β receptor II (dNTGF-βRII) to overcome immunosuppression in solid tumors—plus a truncated EGFR safety switch for in vivo elimination. The competitive significance lies in addressing two major CAR-T limitations: solid tumor infiltration/suppression and lack of controllable elimination, positioning this as a next-generation CAR-T platform with enhanced efficacy and safety.
patents.title_original: PRÉPARATION POUR CELLULES À RÉCEPTEUR ANTIGÉNIQUE CHIMÉRIQUE (CAR) AMÉLIORÉES ET LEUR UTILISATION

patents.title: GENETICALLY MODIFIED HEMATOPOIETIC STEM CELL AND ITS USE IN COMBINATION WITH CAR-T LYMPHOCYTE
patents.abstract: Provided are a method for changing an antigenic epitope of a cell, and a cell prepared by means of using the method. Further provided are a method and a pharmaceutical composition for treating tumors by means of using the cell in combination with a CAR-T cell or an antibody drug. The cell with the changed antigenic epitope is not killed by the CAR-T or the antibody drug, and can be infused into a patient to alleviate the side effects of a CAR-T product or an antibody drug in tumor treatment.
patents.assignee: SHANGHAI IASO BIOTECHNOLOGY CO LTD [CN]; 上海驯鹿生物技术有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: This patent presents genetically modified hematopoietic stem cells engineered to eliminate CAR-T-recognizing antigenic epitopes, enabling co-infusion with CAR-T cells to mitigate cytokine release syndrome and off-target toxicity. The competitive significance lies in addressing a critical safety challenge in CAR-T therapy by using epitope-edited cells as a toxicity buffer, potentially improving tolerability and enabling higher CAR-T doses in in vivo applications.
patents.title_original: CELLULE SOUCHE HÉMATOPOÏÉTIQUE GÉNÉTIQUEMENT MODIFIÉE ET SON UTILISATION EN COMBINAISON AVEC LYMPHOCYTE CAR-T

patents.title: Universal Chimeric Antigen Receptor T Lymphocyte and Its Application
patents.abstract: A cell comprising a mutant protein, the mutant protein causing the cell to be insensitive toward an inhibitor which affects the activity and/or killing function thereof; a universal chimeric antigen receptor T cell which is related to the cell and which is suitable for administration to non-specific patients; and a method for preparing the described cells and an application of the cells in cell therapy.
patents.assignee: SHANGHAI IASO BIOTECHNOLOGY CO LTD [CN]; 上海驯鹿生物技术有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes universal CAR-T cells engineered with mutant proteins that confer insensitivity to inhibitory signals, enabling off-the-shelf therapeutic administration across non-specific patients. The competitive significance lies in addressing a key limitation of conventional CAR-T therapy—patient-specific manufacturing timelines and cost—while potentially improving in vivo persistence and efficacy through resistance to immunosuppressive signals in the tumor microenvironment.
patents.title_original: LYMPHOCYTE T RÉCEPTEUR ANTIGÉNIQUE CHIMÉRIQUE UNIVERSEL ET SON APPLICATION

patents.title: Neutralizing monoclonal antibodies targeting single chain antibodies
patents.abstract: The invention relates to a neutralizing monoclonal antibody targeting a single-chain antibody, in particular to a separated antigen binding protein, and the antigen comprises a chimeric antigen receptor targeting a B cell maturation antigen (BCMA). The invention also provides an application of the antigen binding protein in detection of a chimeric antigen receptor.
patents.assignee: NANJING IASO BIOTHERAPEUTICS TECH CO LTD; 南京驯鹿医疗技术有限公司; 南京驯鹿生物技术股份有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes neutralizing monoclonal antibodies designed to bind and target single-chain antibody components, specifically those incorporated into BCMA-directed CAR-T constructs. The competitive significance lies in providing reagents for CAR construct detection and potentially neutralization, which could be useful for quality control, manufacturing monitoring, or as a counter-measure to CAR-T therapies.

patents.title: FULLY HUMANIZED ANTIBODY TARGETING CD5
patents.abstract: Provided is a CD5-targeting fully humanized antibody or an antigen binding fragment thereof, which specifically binds to CD5 with a high affinity, has a lower immunogenicity compared with heterologous antibodies, and has a good application potential in the development of an antibody drug, a cell therapy drug detection reagent and the like.
patents.assignee: NANJING IASO BIOTHERAPEUTICS CO LTD [CN]; 南京驯鹿医疗技术有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent claims a fully humanized anti-CD5 antibody or antigen-binding fragment with high affinity binding and reduced immunogenicity compared to heterologous antibodies. The competitive significance for in vivo CAR-T is moderate: while CD5 is a validated T-cell surface antigen, anti-CD5 antibodies are primarily positioned for antibody drug development and detection reagents rather than as core CAR-T engineering components; however, such antibodies could serve ancillary roles in CAR-T manufacturing (depletion), quality control, or combination therapies.
patents.title_original: ANTICORPS ENTIÈREMENT HUMANISÉ CIBLANT CD5

patents.title: Fully Human Antibody Targeting CD5, Fully Human Chimeric Antigen Receptor (CAR) and Associated Use
patents.abstract: Provided is a CD5 antibody. Also provided is a chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) that can specifically bind to a CD5 protein, comprising a CD5 binding domain, a transmembrane domain, a costimulatory domain, and an intracellular signaling domain. Also provided is an engineered immune effector cell (such as a T cell) containing the CAR. Also provided is an application of the CAR and the engineered immune effector cell in the treatment of diseases or symptoms related to the expression of CD5.
patents.assignee: NANJING IASO BIOTHERAPEUTICS CO LTD [CN]; 南京驯鹿医疗技术有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent claims a fully human CD5-targeting CAR construct with integrated transmembrane, costimulatory, and intracellular signaling domains, along with engineered T cells expressing this CAR for treatment of CD5-expressing diseases. The competitive significance lies in targeting CD5+ malignancies (particularly T-cell lymphomas and chronic lymphocytic leukemia) with a fully human CAR design intended to reduce immunogenicity compared to chimeric or humanized alternatives.
patents.title_original: ANTICORPS ENTIÈREMENT HUMAIN CIBLANT CD5, RÉCEPTEUR ANTIGÉNIQUE CHIMÉRIQUE ENTIÈREMENT HUMAIN (CAR) ET UTILISATION ASSOCIÉE

patents.title: ANTIBODIES AND CHIMERIC ANTIGEN RECEPTOR (CAR) BINDING TO CD70, AND ASSOCIATED APPLICATION
patents.abstract: A CD70 antibody and a chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) that can specifically bind to a CD70 protein. The CAR comprises a CD70 binding domain, a transmembrane domain, a costimulatory domain, and an intracellular signaling domain. Further disclosed is an application of the antibody and the CAR for treating diseases or conditions related to CD70 expression.
patents.assignee: NANJING IASO BIOTHERAPEUTICS CO LTD [CN]; 南京驯鹿医疗技术有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent discloses CD70-targeting CAR-T constructs comprising a CD70 binding domain paired with costimulatory and intracellular signaling domains, applied to treat CD70-expressing diseases. This represents a specific CAR targeting strategy potentially valuable for hematologic malignancies (lymphomas, leukemias) and solid tumors expressing CD70, offering a differentiated target within the CAR-T landscape dominated by CD19 and other targets.
patents.title_original: ANTICORPS ET RÉCEPTEUR ANTIGÉNIQUE CHIMÉRIQUE (CAR) SE LIANT À CD70, ET APPLICATION ASSOCIÉE

patents.title: RECEPTEUR ANTIGENIQUE CHIMERIQUE BISPECIFIQUE ENTIEREMENT HUMANISE CIBLANT CD19 ET CD22 ET SES UTILISATIONS
patents.abstract:
[0001]    Provided is a bispecific chimeric antigen receptor targeting CD19 and CD22, which comprises extracellular antigen binding domains of heavy-chain variable regions and light-chain variable regions of anti-CD19 and anti-CD22 antibodies. Further provided is a bispecific CAR-T cell targeting CD19 and CD22.
[0002]    L'invention concerne un récepteur antigénique chimérique bispécifique ciblant CD19 et CD22, qui comprend des domaines de liaison à l'antigène extracellulaire de régions variables de chaîne lourde et de régions variables de chaîne légère d'anticorps anti-CD19 et anti-CD22. L'invention concerne en outre une cellule CAR-T bispécifique ciblant CD19 et CD22.
patents.assignee: NANJING IASO BIOTHERAPEUTICS CO LTD [CN]; NANJING IASO BIOTHERAPEUTICS CO., LTD.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent discloses a bispecific CAR construct simultaneously targeting CD19 and CD22 using fully humanized variable domains from anti-CD19 and anti-CD22 antibodies, along with CAR-T cells engineered with this construct. The dual-targeting approach addresses antigen escape and tumor heterogeneity in B-cell malignancies, offering potential competitive advantage over single-specificity CAR-T therapies currently in clinical use.

patents.title: EXTRACELLULAR VESICLES TARGETING CANCER CELLS AND THEIR USES
patents.abstract: Provided are an extracellular vesicle (EV) and a method for producing the EV. The extracellular vesicle comprising a pharmaceutical composition inside the EV and a targeting polypeptide associated with the membrane of the EV for targeted delivery of the pharmaceutical composition.
patents.assignee: NANJING IASO BIOTHERAPEUTICS CO LTD [CN]
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes engineered extracellular vesicles (EVs) with membrane-associated targeting polypeptides for directed delivery of pharmaceutical compositions to cancer cells. This approach is relevant to CAR-T and gene therapy as EVs represent an alternative or complementary delivery platform to viral vectors, offering potential advantages in immunogenicity profile and manufacturing scalability for delivering therapeutic payloads (nucleic acids, proteins) to target tissues.
patents.title_original: VÉSICULES EXTRACELLULAIRES CIBLANT DES CELLULES CANCÉREUSES ET LEURS UTILISATIONS

patents.title: RECEPTEUR ANTIGENIQUE CHIMERIQUE ANTI-CD22 HUMAIN ENTIEREMENT HUMAIN ET SON UTILISATION
patents.abstract:
[0001]    The present invention provides an anti-CD22 antibody molecule and a CD22-targeted chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) constructed using the anti-CD22 antibody molecule. The present invention also provides an application of the anti-CD22 antibody molecule and the CAR in the preparation of drugs for treating CD22-related diseases.
[0002]    La présente invention concerne une molécule d'anticorps anti-CD22 et un récepteur antigénique chimérique (CAR) ciblant CD22 construit à l'aide de la molécule d'anticorps anti-CD22. La présente invention concerne également une utilisation de la molécule d'anticorps anti-CD22 et du CAR dans la préparation de médicaments pour le traitement de maladies liées à CD22.
patents.assignee: NANJING IASO BIOTHERAPEUTICS CO LTD [CN]; NANJING IASO BIOTHERAPEUTICS CO., LTD.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes a fully human anti-CD22 antibody molecule and a CD22-targeted CAR construct derived from this antibody, with application to CD22-related disease treatment. The competitive significance lies in providing a potentially improved CAR-T platform targeting CD22 (relevant for B-cell malignancies like B-ALL and lymphomas) using a fully human antibody scaffold, which may reduce immunogenicity compared to chimeric or humanized alternatives.

patents.title: Fully human antibody targeting CD19 and application thereof
patents.abstract: Provided are a fully human antibody targeting CD19 or a single chain antibody or fragment thereof. Further provided is a chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) constructed by using a single chain antibody (scFv) derived from the fully human antibody. The fully human antibody and the CAR can be used for the construction of CAR-T cells targeting CD19. Compared with CAR-T cells using murine antibodies, the CAR-T cells have better compatibility with the human body, which is beneficial to their long-term proliferation and survival in the body.
patents.assignee: NANJING IASO BIOTECHNOLOGY CO LTD [CN]; NANJING IASO BIOTECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent presents a fully human anti-CD19 antibody and derived scFv for CAR construction, claiming superior human compatibility and prolonged in vivo persistence compared to murine antibody-based CAR-T cells. The competitive advantage centers on reduced immunogenicity and improved durability of CAR-T cells in human subjects.

patents.title: T CELL EXPRESSING CHIMERIC ANTIGEN RECEPTOR, CHIMERIC ANTIGEN-RELATED EXPRESSION VECTOR AND USE THEREOF
patents.abstract: Provided is a T cell expressing a chimeric antigen receptor. The chimeric antigen receptor comprises an extracellular domain, and the extracellular domain recognizes a target antigen on the surface ofa target cell, thereby mediating the killing of the target cell by the T cell. The T cell itself also expresses the target antigen, and in order to prevent the T cells from killing each other, the expression of the target antigen in the T cell is down-regulated. An expression vector comprising a sequence coding the chimeric antigen receptor is also provided. The T cell provided can be used to treat diseases caused by abnormal proliferation of CS1 positive cells by targeting CS1 antigen, meanwhile, the T cells are prevented from killing each other due to down-regulation of CS1 expression of the T cell, facilitating expansion and survival of the T cell in vitro and in vivo.
patents.assignee: NANJING IASO BIOTHERAPEUTICS TECH CO LTD; 南京驯鹿医疗技术有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes CAR-T cells engineered to express a chimeric antigen receptor targeting CS1 antigen while simultaneously downregulating CS1 expression on the T cells themselves to prevent fratricide/T cell-to-T cell killing. This dual engineering approach—combining target recognition with self-antigen suppression—addresses a significant challenge in CAR-T therapy by improving cell survival and therapeutic efficacy in treating CS1+ hematologic malignancies.

patents.title: CHIMERIC ANTIGEN RECEPTOR (CAR) BINDING TO BCMA, AND APPLICATIONS THEREOF
patents.abstract: To provide a chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) which can specifically bind to a B-cell maturation antigen (BCMA), and methods for application of the CAR to treatment of diseases or conditions linked to the expression of BCMA.SOLUTION: The present disclosure provides a CAR that comprises a BCMA-binding domain, a transmembrane domain, a costimulatory domain and an intracellular signal transduction domain, each domain comprising a sequence selected from specific sequences, an immune effector cell that comprises a vector comprising a nucleic acid molecule encoding the CAR, and a composition comprising the immune effector cell.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
patents.assignee: NANJING IASO BIOTHERAPEUTICS CO LTD; INNOVENT BIOLOGICS SUZHOU CO LTD; 南京馴鹿医療技術有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent claims a BCMA-targeting CAR construct comprising specific BCMA-binding, transmembrane, costimulatory, and intracellular signaling domains, along with immune effector cells engineered to express this CAR and therapeutic compositions thereof. This is relevant to in vivo CAR-T therapy as BCMA is a validated target for multiple myeloma and light chain disease, with competitive significance depending on the specificity/affinity of the claimed binding domain and the optimization of the functional domains for enhanced T cell persistence and anti-tumor efficacy.

patents.title: COMPOSITION AND METHOD OF CELLULAR IMMUNOTHERAPY
patents.abstract: The present application relates to a fusion protein having a function of resisting transplantation rejection, and an engineering cell for expressing the fusion protein, further relates to a method for resisting transplant immune rejection, and in particular to a method for resisting NK cell immune rejection. The present application relates to a cellular therapy.
patents.assignee: CARSGEN LIFE SCIENCES CO LTD [CN]; 恺兴生命科技（上海）有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes a fusion protein designed to confer transplantation rejection resistance when expressed in engineered cells, with specific focus on NK cell immune evasion. This is relevant to in vivo CAR-T therapy as it addresses a critical challenge in allogeneic CAR-T applications—host immune rejection of adoptively transferred cells—potentially enabling off-the-shelf, universal CAR-T products with improved persistence and efficacy.
patents.title_original: COMPOSITION ET MÉTHODE D'IMMUNOTHÉRAPIE CELLULAIRE

patents.title: Composition and Method of Cell Immunotherapy
patents.abstract: This disclosure pertains to a nucleic acid encoding a fusion protein that specifically targets CD300A. It also provides pluralities of nucleic acids that further comprise a chimeric receptor-encoding nucleic acid, such as a nucleic acid encoding a NK-targeting CAR. Vectors, compositions, engineered cells, and populations of cells containing such nucleic acids are also provided herein. Uses of these fusion proteins, nucleic acids, vectors, engineered cells, or populations of engineered cells in promoting resistance to NK cell-mediated cytotoxicity in an allogeneic setting, preventing or treating transplant rejection, and preventing or treating diseases, such as cancers or autoimmune diseases, are also provided herein.
patents.assignee: CARSGEN LIFE SCIENCES CO LTD [CN]; CARSGEN LIFE SCIENCES CO., LTD
patents.novelty_summary: The patent discloses engineered cells expressing a CD300A-targeting fusion protein combined with NK-targeting CAR constructs to confer resistance to NK cell-mediated cytotoxicity in allogeneic settings. This addresses a critical challenge in allogeneic CAR-T therapy by protecting donor cells from host NK cell rejection, with applications in cancer treatment and transplant rejection prevention.
patents.title_original: COMPOSITION ET MÉTHODE D'IMMUNOTHÉRAPIE CELLULAIRE

patents.title: METHOD FOR TREATING TUMOR USING IMMUNE CELL
patents.abstract: The present application provides a new adjuvant treatment method for treating tumors, reducing tumor recurrence, inhibiting tumor growth, or inducing tumor necrosis, wherein the method comprises the following: after selecting patients with cancer (for example, liver cancer, pancreatic cancer, gastric cancer, or gastroesophageal junction tumor) in need thereof for tumor local treatment, a therapeutically effective amount of immune cells (for example, CAR-T cells) is administered as a new adjuvant treatment.
patents.assignee: CARSGEN THERAPEUTICS CO LTD [CN]; CARSGEN THERAPEUTICS CO., LTD.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes a neoadjuvant/adjuvant treatment approach using CAR-T cells in combination with local tumor treatment for solid tumors (liver, pancreatic, gastric cancers). The competitive significance lies in positioning CAR-T as a combination therapy partner with conventional local treatments rather than as monotherapy, potentially addressing CAR-T limitations in solid tumor penetration and immunosuppressive microenvironments.

patents.title: COMPOSITION FOR CELL IMMUNOTHERAPY AND METHOD
patents.abstract: A chimeric receptor having an anti-transplant rejection function, an engineered cell expressing the chimeric receptor, an anti-tumor and anti-transplant immune rejection method, and in particular an anti-NK cell immune rejection method. Also provided is a cell therapy.
patents.assignee: CARSGEN THERAPEUTICS CO LTD [CN]; 科济生物医药（上海）有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent discloses chimeric receptors with dual anti-tumor and anti-transplant rejection functions, particularly targeting NK cell-mediated immune rejection, along with engineered cells expressing these receptors. The competitive significance lies in addressing transplant rejection immunity while maintaining anti-tumor efficacy, potentially enabling CAR-T/CAR-NK cell therapies in allogeneic transplant settings where host immune responses typically eliminate engineered cells.
patents.title_original: COMPOSITION POUR IMMUNOTHÉRAPIE CELLULAIRE ET MÉTHODE

patents.title: CELLULE EFFECTRICE IMMUNITAIRE ET SON UTILISATION
patents.abstract: Provided are an immune effector cell targeting CD19 and CD20, and use thereof. The immune effector cell comprises a scFv targeting CD19 and CD20, a hinge region, a transmembrane region, and an intracellular signal domain. Further provided are a polynucleotide targeting CD19 and CD20, a corresponding expression vector, a CAR-T cell, and use thereof.
patents.assignee: CARSGEN THERAPEUTICS CO LTD [CN]; 科济生物医药（上海）有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes a dual-targeting CAR-T cell engineered to recognize both CD19 and CD20 antigens through a single-chain variable fragment (scFv), with defined structural components (hinge, transmembrane, signaling domain). This dual-specificity approach is significant for in vivo CAR-T therapy as it may reduce antigen escape and enhance efficacy in B-cell malignancies by targeting two complementary surface antigens simultaneously, potentially improving clinical outcomes over single-antigen CAR-T constructs.

patents.title: Compositions and methods for cellular immunotherapy
patents.abstract: The invention relates to a fusion protein with an anti-transplant rejection function, an engineering cell for expressing the fusion protein, and a method for resisting transplant immunological rejection, in particular to a method for resisting NK (Natural Killer) cell immunological rejection. The invention relates to cell therapy.
patents.assignee: CARSGEN THERAPEUTICS SHANGHAI CO LTD; 科济生物医药（上海）有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The invention describes a fusion protein designed to prevent transplant rejection by modulating NK cell responses, with engineered cells expressing this construct for cell therapy applications. The competitive significance lies in addressing immunological rejection in cellular immunotherapy contexts, potentially relevant to allogeneic CAR-T or other engineered cell therapies where NK cell-mediated rejection of donor cells is a clinical barrier.

patents.title: Fusion protein and application thereof
patents.abstract: The invention provides a novel structure targeting FAP and tumor antigen fusion protein, and the application of the novel structure can improve the infiltration of immune effector cells in tumors, improve the tumor microenvironment and improve the killing effect on the tumors.
patents.assignee: CARSGEN THERAPEUTICS SHANGHAI CO LTD; 科济生物医药（上海）有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent discloses a dual-targeting fusion protein that recognizes both FAP (fibroblast activation protein) and tumor-associated antigens, designed to enhance immune effector cell infiltration into the tumor microenvironment. This approach is competitive for in vivo CAR-T as it addresses a key therapeutic limitation—poor T cell penetration—by modulating the immunosuppressive stroma through FAP targeting while simultaneously engaging tumor cells.

patents.title: Method and Composition for Cell Immunotherapy
patents.abstract: Provided are a fusion protein having a function of preventing transplantation rejection and an engineering cell expressing the fusion protein. The present invention further relates to a method against transplantation immunological rejection, in particular to a method against NK cell immunological rejection.
patents.assignee: CARSGEN THERAPEUTIC CO LTD [CN]; 科济生物医药（上海）有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent presents a fusion protein designed to prevent transplantation rejection, expressed in engineered cells, with particular focus on NK cell-mediated rejection. This is relevant to CAR-T immunotherapy as it addresses a critical challenge in allogeneic cell therapy—immune rejection of transplanted therapeutic cells—by combining immunomodulatory fusion proteins with cell engineering approaches.
patents.title_original: MÉTHODE ET COMPOSITION D'IMMUNOTHÉRAPIE CELLULAIRE

patents.title: NKG2D-MODIFIED CELL AND ASSOCIATED COMPOSITION
patents.abstract: An engineered immune cell for use in immunotherapy and a preparation method therefor. The engineered immune cell is more persistent in a host organism and has a high transplantation survival rate.
patents.assignee: CARSGEN THERAPEUTICS CO LTD [CN]; 科济生物医药（上海）有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes engineered immune cells with NKG2D modification designed to improve persistence and transplantation survival in vivo. The competitive significance for in vivo CAR-T lies in enhanced durability through NKG2D-based engineering, potentially addressing a key limitation of CAR-T therapy (T cell exhaustion and short persistence), though the abstract lacks specifics on mechanism (e.g., whether NKG2D acts as co-stimulatory domain, engages NK receptors, or enables recognition of stress ligands).
patents.title_original: CELLULE MODIFIÉE NKG2D ET COMPOSITION ASSOCIÉE

patents.title: ANTICORPS ET SON UTILISATION
patents.abstract: The present invention relates to an antibody that specifically binds to CLDN6, and the use thereof.
patents.assignee: CARSGEN THERAPEUTICS CO LTD [CN]; 科济生物医药（上海）有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: A novel anti-CLDN6 antibody with potential application in CAR-T cell therapy targeting claudin-6-expressing cancers. CLDN6 is an emerging tumor-associated antigen relevant for solid tumor CAR-T approaches, offering a differentiated target from conventional hematologic malignancy antigens.

patents.title: CHIMERIC POLYPEPTIDE AND ITS USE
patents.abstract: Provided are an antibody/T cell receptor chimera carrying different signal peptides and the use thereof. The provided chimeric polypeptide contains a chain A and a chain B, wherein the chain A contains a first antigen binding domain and a first constant region, and the chain B contains a second antigen binding domain and a second constant region: (i) the first and/or second antigen binding domain is a heavy chain or heavy chain variable region of an antibody, which is operably linked to a heavy chain signal peptide or a TCR subunit signal peptide; and (ii) the first and/or second antigen binding domain is a light chain or light chain variable region of an antibody, which is operably linked to a light chain signal peptide or a TCR subunit signal peptide.
patents.assignee: CARSGEN LIFE SCIENCES CO LTD [CN]; 恺兴生命科技（上海）有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent discloses a chimeric antibody/TCR polypeptide with dual antigen-binding domains where signal peptides can be flexibly assigned from either antibody (heavy/light chain) or TCR subunit origins. The competitive significance lies in optimizing expression levels and subcellular trafficking of multi-domain binding proteins in engineered T cells, potentially improving CAR-T construct efficiency through improved protein synthesis and membrane localization.
patents.title_original: POLYPEPTIDE CHIMÉRIQUE ET SON UTILISATION

patents.title: COMPOSITIONS AND METHODS FOR CELLULAR IMMUNOLOGY
patents.abstract: The present invention relates to a bispecific molecule targeting NK cells, and relates to a method for resisting transplant immune rejection caused by NK cells, and particularly relates to a method for providing antibodies targeting NK cells or for providing cells which secrete antibodies targeting NK cells, so as to resist transplant immune rejection caused by NK cells of an individual receiving a transplant. The present invention also relates to CRISPR/Cas-related methods, compositions, and components for editing a target nucleic acid sequence or modulating the expression of a target nucleic acid sequence.
patents.assignee: CARSGEN LIFE SCIENCES CO LTD [CN]; 恺兴生命科技（上海）有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent presents bispecific molecules targeting NK cells to prevent transplant immune rejection, combined with CRISPR/Cas-based nucleic acid editing and expression modulation approaches. The innovation lies in combining NK cell targeting with gene editing technology for transplant immunotolerance, which is relevant to CAR-T engineering where similar approaches could be applied to enhance cell persistence and reduce rejection of adoptively transferred T cells in allogeneic settings.
patents.title_original: COMPOSITIONS ET PROCÉDÉS POUR IMMUNOLOGIE CELLULAIRE

patents.title: ANTICORPS GPRC5D ET SON UTILISATION
patents.abstract: The present application relates to an antibody that binds to GPRC5D and use thereof. The present application further relates to a cell, a pharmaceutical composition, and a combination therapy comprising the antibody that binds to GPRC5D, and a method for preparing the antibody.
patents.assignee: CARSGEN LIFE SCIENCES CO LTD [CN]; 恺兴生命科技（上海）有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent covers antibodies targeting GPRC5D with applications in cell-based therapies, likely CAR-T constructs given CARSGEN's focus. GPRC5D is a validated myeloma antigen, and CAR-T targeting this epitope represents a clinically significant advancement in MM treatment with differentiated toxicity profiles compared to existing BCMA-directed approaches.

patents.title: ANTICORPS NKG2A ET SON UTILISATION
patents.abstract: The present invention relates to an antibody targeting NKG2A and an application thereof. Disclosed in the present invention is a novel fully human antibody capable of specifically recognizing NKG2A. The antibody of the present invention can effectively block the binding of HLA-E of tumor cells to NKG2A/CD94 of NK cells, reduces the inhibiting effect of the tumor cells expressing HLA-E on the NK cells by means of NKG2A/CD94 pathway, and enhances the killing effect of the NK cells on the tumor cells.
patents.assignee: CARSGEN LIFE SCIENCES CO LTD [CN]; 恺兴生命科技（上海）有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: A fully human anti-NKG2A monoclonal antibody that blocks the HLA-E/NKG2A-CD94 inhibitory checkpoint, thereby enhancing NK cell cytotoxicity against HLA-E-expressing tumors. This represents a checkpoint blockade approach complementary to CAR-T strategies, with potential synergistic applications in combination cell therapy.

patents.title: METHOD FOR INDUCING CELL DIFFERENTIATION
patents.abstract: Provided are a culture platform, a cell culture medium, and a method for differentiating pluripotent stem cells into a hematopoietic lineage. A pluripotent stem cell-derived hematopoietic lineage produced by using the present culture platform and method can be produced by means of a monolayer culture without serum or trophoblasts, and without forming embryoid bodies. The pluripotent stem cell-derived hematopoietic lineage comprises hematopoietic endothelial cells, hematopoietic stem cells, hematopoietic pluripotent progenitor cells, hematopoietic progenitor cells, T progenitor cells, NK progenitor cells, T cells, and NK cells.
patents.assignee: CARSGEN THERAPEUTICS CO LTD [CN]; 科济生物医药（上海）有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes a serum-free, monolayer culture platform and method for differentiating pluripotent stem cells into hematopoietic lineage cells including T cells and NK cells without embryoid body formation. This is significant for CAR-T manufacturing as it offers a defined, scalable production method potentially enabling generation of CAR-T cells from iPSCs rather than relying on patient-derived peripheral blood, with potential advantages in consistency, GMP compliance, and off-the-shelf therapeutic development.
patents.title_original: PROCÉDÉ POUR INDUIRE UNE DIFFÉRENCIATION CELLULAIRE

patents.title: CHIMERIC POLYPEPTIDE FOR THE REGULATION OF CELLULAR PHYSIOLOGICAL ACTIVITY
patents.abstract: A chimeric polypeptide, containing a binding peptide that can specifically bind to a target molecule, a receptor regulatory domain containing one or more cleavage sites, and an intracellular domain. The receptor regulatory domain comprises an extracellular region and a transmembrane region, wherein the extracellular region and the transmembrane region are not both derived from a Notch protein. The binding of the binding peptide to the target molecule can induce the cleavage of the receptor regulatory domain, thereby releasing the intracellular domain.
patents.assignee: CARSGEN THERAPEUTICS CO LTD [CN]; 科济生物医药（上海）有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes a chimeric polypeptide with a modular architecture comprising a binding peptide, a receptor regulatory domain with cleavage sites (not entirely derived from Notch), and an intracellular domain. The novelty lies in the engineered receptor regulatory domain that enables ligand-binding-induced proteolytic release of the intracellular domain, offering a controllable activation mechanism distinct from native Notch signaling. This has competitive significance for CAR-T engineering by enabling inducible, target-dependent activation of signaling domains with potential advantages in reducing basal activation and improving therapeutic control.
patents.title_original: POLYPEPTIDE CHIMÉRIQUE POUR LA RÉGULATION DE L'ACTIVITÉ PHYSIOLOGIQUE CELLULAIRE

patents.title: METHOD AND COMPOSITION FOR TUMOR TREATMENT
patents.abstract: A treatment method for administration of immune effector cells to an individual suffering from or suspected of suffering from a CLD18 positive biliary tract tumor, comprising administrating immune effector cells that specifically recognize CLD18.2 to an individual. Pretreatment is performed and then the immune effector cells of the present application are administered, so that the tumor treatment efficacy of the immune effector cells can be remarkably improved.
patents.assignee: CARSGEN THERAPEUTICS CO LTD [CN]; 科济生物医药（上海）有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent presents immune effector cells engineered to specifically recognize CLD18.2 antigen on biliary tract tumors, combined with a pretreatment regimen designed to enhance therapeutic efficacy. This represents a clinically relevant CAR-T approach targeting a solid tumor-associated antigen (CLD18.2) with an optimized treatment protocol, offering competitive advantage in the underexplored biliary cancer indication.
patents.title_original: MÉTHODE ET COMPOSITION DE TRAITEMENT DE TUMEURS

patents.title: CS1 engineered cells and compositions thereof
patents.abstract: The invention provides an antigen binding unit capable of targeting CS1 and application of the antigen binding unit. The present invention relates to a CS1-targeting antigen binding unit, a chimeric receptor, an immunoconjugate comprising the CS1-targeting antigen binding unit, a chimeric receptor, and nucleic acids encoding the CS1-targeting antigen binding unit, the immunoconjugate, and the chimeric receptor. The invention also relates to application of the CS1-targeting antigen binding unit, the immunoconjugate, the chimeric receptor and the host cell for treating diseases.
patents.assignee: CARSGEN THERAPEUTICS SHANGHAI CO LTD; 科济生物医药（上海）有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes CS1-targeting antigen binding units and chimeric receptors (likely CAR constructs) for engineering T cells to treat CS1-expressing diseases, particularly multiple myeloma. The competitive significance lies in providing an alternative CAR-T targeting approach to CS1, a validated myeloma-associated antigen, with potential advantages in specificity or manufacturing compared to existing BCMA or GPRC5D-targeted CAR-T therapies.

patents.title: TIGIT engineered cells and compositions thereof
patents.abstract: The present invention relates to engineered immune cells for use in immunotherapy, which are more persistent and/or have a high transplantation survival rate in a host organism, and a method for preparing the same. The invention relates to a genetically engineered cell, characterized in that said cell expresses a first protein that recognizes TIGIT, and to a method for increasing the persistence and/or transplant survival rate of a first immune cell in the presence of a host second immune cell.
patents.assignee: CARSGEN THERAPEUTICS SHANGHAI CO LTD; 科济生物医药（上海）有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes immune cells engineered to express TIGIT-recognizing proteins, designed to enhance persistence and transplant survival in host organisms. This addresses a key challenge in adoptive cell therapy by modulating immunosuppressive checkpoint pathways, offering competitive advantage in CAR-T durability and in vivo efficacy.

patents.title: Method for transduction of cells by viral vectors
patents.abstract: The present invention provides methods of making genetically engineered cells, as well as the obtained cells and compositions thereof transduced with recombinant or heterologous genes, and methods of use in adoptive immunotherapy.
patents.assignee: CARSGEN THERAPEUTICS SHANGHAI CO LTD; 科济生物医药（上海）有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: This patent covers methods for viral vector-mediated transduction of cells with recombinant genes for adoptive immunotherapy applications, likely including CAR-T cell engineering. The competitive significance lies in protecting viral transduction techniques and the resulting genetically engineered cell compositions used in CAR-T manufacturing, a core enabling technology for cell therapy production.

patents.title: CELLS AND METHODS RESISTANT TO TRANSPLANTATION REJECTION
patents.abstract: To provide cells resistant to transplantation immunological rejection and methods for resisting inhibition or rejection.SOLUTION: The cell expresses a first protein capable of recognizing one or more immune effector cells of a host. Preferably, the cell has a function of inhibiting or killing the immune effector cells of the host. Also provided are a method for preventing or regulating transplantation immunological rejection, and a method for preventing or regulating attacks on exogenous cells by NK cells.SELECTED DRAWING: None
patents.assignee: CARSGEN THERAPEUTICS CO LTD; ▲かい▼興生命科技（上海）有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes engineered cells expressing proteins that recognize and inhibit/kill host immune effector cells (particularly NK cells) to prevent transplant rejection. This is relevant to CAR-T immunogenicity mitigation, as it addresses a key challenge in allogeneic cell therapy—evading host immunity through expression of inhibitory ligands or engineered immune-evasive factors on therapeutic cell surfaces.

patents.title: Method of Transduction of Cells with a Viral Vector
patents.abstract: Provided is a method for transducing cells with a viral vector, and further provided are cells obtained through recombination or heterologous gene transduction and compositions thereof, and a method for using same in adoptive immunotherapy. Under the premise of not affecting the expression of recombinant nucleic acid, the method shortens the activation and transduction time during the preparation process of genetically engineered cells.
patents.assignee: CARSGEN THERAPEUTICS CO LTD [CN]; 科济生物医药（上海）有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent presents a method for viral vector transduction of cells that reduces activation and transduction time during genetically engineered cell preparation while maintaining recombinant nucleic acid expression. This is significant for CAR-T manufacturing as process optimization directly impacts cost, scalability, and clinical throughput—critical factors for commercial CAR-T cell therapy production.
patents.title_original: MÉTHODE DE TRANSDUCTION DE CELLULES AVEC UN VECTEUR VIRAL

patents.title: Anti-Claudin18.2 antibody and application thereof
patents.abstract: Provided is an antibody or antigen binding fragment capable of recognizing an antigen peptide comprising SEQ ID NO: 7 (KNKKIYDGG); or an epitope containing SEQ ID NO: 7 in the claudin18.2 is identified; preferably, a peptide comprising SEQ ID NO: 6 (KNKKIYDGGART) is identified; or the epitope containing SEQ ID NO: 6 in the claudin18.2 is identified.
patents.assignee: CARSGEN THERAPEUTICS CO LTD; 佧珐药业有限公司; 上海恺兴诊断技术有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes antibodies or antigen-binding fragments targeting specific epitopes within claudin18.2 (a tumor-associated antigen). For CAR-T applications, this is relevant as claudin18.2-targeting CAR-T cells represent an emerging therapeutic approach for solid tumors (gastric, pancreatic cancers); however, the patent focuses on antibody generation rather than CAR construct design, manufacturing, or clinical methods, limiting direct in vivo CAR-T significance.

patents.title: CELLULE EFFECTRICE IMMUNITAIRE EXPRIMANT IL-15
patents.abstract: Provided is an immune effector cell expressing IL-15; the cells express IL-15 and recognize receptors for specific target antigens, or the cells express IL-15R binding molecules and receptors that recognize specific target antigens. Also provided are a nucleic acid molecule, an IL-15R binding molecule or IL-15 or IL-15 and chemokine expressed by said nucleic acid molecule, a chemokine receptor, a cytokine other than IL-7, an siRNA which reduces PD-1 expression, a protein which blocks the binding of PD-L1 to PD-1, or a safety switch.
patents.assignee: CARSGEN THERAPEUTICS CO LTD [CN]; SHANGHAI CANCER INST [CN]; 科济生物医药（上海）有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes immune effector cells (likely T cells) engineered to express IL-15 alongside antigen recognition receptors, with optional IL-15R binding molecules and immune checkpoint inhibition (PD-1 reduction). This addresses a key limitation in CAR-T persistence and expansion in vivo by providing autocrine/paracrine IL-15 signaling to enhance proliferation, survival, and anti-tumor efficacy without exogenous cytokine administration.

patents.title: IMMUNE EFFECTOR CELL IN WHICH EXPRESSION IS REGULATED BY CYTOKINES
patents.abstract: Provided is a genetically engineered immune effector cell, wherein the immune effector cell expresses a receptor specifically recognizing a target antigen and IL7, and the IL-7 performs an inducible expression and is regulated by the receptor. Further provided are a nucleic acid molecule expressing the immune effector cell and a method for preparing the immune effector cell.
patents.assignee: CARSGEN THERAPEUTICS CO LTD [CN]; SHANGHAI CANCER INST [CN]; 科济生物医药（上海）有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes genetically engineered immune effector cells with inducible IL-7 expression regulated by antigen-recognition receptor signaling, enabling autonomous cytokine production upon target engagement. This approach addresses CAR-T cell persistence and expansion limitations by coupling therapeutic cytokine production to tumor antigen recognition, potentially improving in vivo proliferation and anti-tumor efficacy while reducing systemic cytokine exposure.
patents.title_original: CELLULE EFFECTRICE IMMUNITAIRE DANS LAQUELLE L'EXPRESSION EST RÉGULÉE PAR DES CYTOKINES

patents.title: IMMUNE EFFECTOR CELL FOR CO-EXPRESSING A CHEMOKINE RECEPTOR
patents.abstract: Provided are an immune effector cell for co-expressing a chemokine receptor, a pharmaceutical composition, a kit, and a method for treating a tumor. The immune effector cell comprises a receptor that specifically recognizes claudin 18.2 and a protein that recognizes SDF-1. Further provided are an expression construct, an expression vector, and a virus. The expression construct comprises an expression of a receptor that binds to a tumor-associated antigen and an expression of the protein that recognizes SDF-1, which are connected in sequence.
patents.assignee: CARSGEN THERAPEUTICS CO LTD [CN]; SHANGHAI CANCER INST [CN]; 科济生物医药（上海）有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes engineered immune effector cells (likely CAR-T cells) that co-express a claudin 18.2-targeting receptor and an SDF-1-binding protein (likely CXCR4), enabling dual functionality: tumor-specific recognition and chemokine-guided migration to tumor microenvironments. This addresses a clinically significant problem in CAR-T therapy—poor infiltration and trafficking to solid tumors—by combining antigen-targeting with chemotactic homing, potentially improving efficacy in claudin 18.2+ gastric and other cancers.
patents.title_original: CELLULE EFFECTRICE IMMUNITAIRE POUR CO-EXPRIMER UN RÉCEPTEUR DE CHIMIOKINE

patents.title: TCR FUSION PROTEIN AND CELL EXPRESSING TCR FUSION PROTEIN
patents.abstract: Disclosed is a T cell receptor (TCR) fusion protein (TFP). The fusion protein comprises a TCR subunit (or referred to as a TCR unit) and an antigen recognition unit that recognizes an antigen. The antigen is GPC3 or claudin 18.2. Also disclosed is a T cell containing the fusion protein, a pharmaceutical composition and an application method of using the fusion protein or the T cell to treat diseases such as cancer. The use of TFP or T cells not only inhibits the growth of tumor cells, but also releases fewer cytokines, thereby effectively reducing the possibility of cytokine storms.
patents.assignee: CARSGEN THERAPEUTICS CO LTD; 佧珐药业有限公司; 恺兴生命科技（上海）有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent discloses TCR fusion proteins combining a TCR subunit with an antigen recognition unit targeting GPC3 or claudin 18.2, along with T cells expressing these fusion proteins for cancer treatment. The competitive significance lies in potentially reducing cytokine release compared to conventional CAR-T approaches, addressing a major safety concern (cytokine storm) in adoptive T cell therapy while maintaining anti-tumor efficacy.

patents.title: CELLULAR IMMUNOTHERAPY COMBINATION
patents.abstract: Disclosed is a tumor treatment method, characterized in that immune effector cells and gemcitabine are administered to an individual with a tumor, and the immune effector cells express receptors having a tumor-specific antigen. Also disclosed is a tumor treatment kit, characterized in that the kit comprises 1) immune effector cells expressing receptors that recognize tumor antigens; 2) gemcitabine; 3) a container for for containing the substances of 1) and 2) described above; and 4) drug administration instructions for using the kit to treat a tumor.
patents.assignee: CARSGEN THERAPEUTICS SHANGHAI CO LTD; SHANGHAI CANCER INST; 科济生物医药（上海）有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent discloses a combination therapy pairing CAR-T cells (immune effector cells with tumor-specific antigen receptors) with gemcitabine chemotherapy. The novelty centers on the synergistic co-administration strategy and formulation as a combination kit, potentially addressing tumor microenvironment immunosuppression and chemoresistance—a clinically significant approach for enhancing CAR-T efficacy in solid tumors where gemcitabine is standard-of-care.

patents.title: GEGEN GPC3 GERICHTETE IMMUNEFFEKTORZELLE UND ANWENDUNG DAVON
patents.abstract: [0001]    The present invention relates to an immune effector cell which expresses a chimeric antigen receptor targeting GPC3 and exogenous IL12. The present invention further provides a pharmaceutical composition containing the immune effector cell and a method for treating tumor, particularly GPC3 positive tumor by using the immune effector cell or the pharmaceutical composition. The immune effector cell in the present invention is effective to an entity tumor cell in vitro, and is outstanding in effect of extinguishing the entity tumor cell in vivo.
patents.assignee: CARSGEN THERAPEUTICS CO LTD [CN]; SHANGHAI CANCER INST [CN]; CRAGE MEDICAL CO LTD [CN]
patents.novelty_summary: The invention combines a GPC3-targeting CAR-T cell with exogenous IL-12 expression to enhance anti-tumor efficacy against solid tumors in vivo. The dual engineering approach (CAR + cytokine) addresses a known limitation of CAR-T therapy—poor solid tumor penetration and persistence—and demonstrates competitive significance for improving therapeutic outcomes in hepatocellular carcinoma and other GPC3+ malignancies.

patents.title: TUMOR COMBINED IMMUNOTHERAPY
patents.abstract: Provided is a method for tumor treatment, comprising administering immune effector cells and a PARP inhibitor to an individual suffering from a tumor, the immune effector cells expressing a receptor for identifying a tumor antigen. Further provided is a kit for tumor treatment.
patents.assignee: CARSGEN THERAPEUTICS SHANGHAI CO LTD; SHANGHAI CANCER INST; 科济生物医药（上海）有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent claims combination therapy using immune effector cells (likely CAR-T) engineered to express tumor antigen-recognizing receptors together with PARP inhibitors to enhance anti-tumor efficacy. The novelty lies in the synergistic approach of combining engineered T cell immunotherapy with DNA repair inhibition, potentially overcoming resistance mechanisms and improving CAR-T cell persistence or tumor killing capacity in vivo.

patents.title: CLL1-TARGETING ANTIBODY AND APPLICATION THEREOF
patents.abstract: Provided are a CLL1-targeting antibody and an application thereof. The CLL1-specific antibody has high affinity for CLL1, and after being prepared into a chimeric antigen receptor-modified T cell, has a significant killing effect on cells expressing CLL1.
patents.assignee: CARSGEN THERAPEUTICS CO LTD; 佧珐药业有限公司; 科济生物医药（上海）有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes a CLL1-targeting antibody with high affinity engineered into a chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) construct for T cell modification, targeting CLL1-expressing cells. This is significant for in vivo CAR-T therapy as CLL1 is a validated acute myeloid leukemia (AML) antigen, and the claimed high-affinity antibody-derived CAR may offer improved tumor recognition and cytotoxic activity compared to existing CLL1-CAR approaches.

patents.title: CHEMOKINE EXPRESSING CELL AND USE THEREOF
patents.abstract: The present invention relates to a chemokine expressing cell. The cell expresses an exogenous IL-21R binding protein or an exogenous IL-21 and an exogenous chemokine. Further provided is a cell expressing an exogenous receptor, an exogenous IL-21R binding protein or an exogenous IL-21 and an exogenous chemokine. The cell involved is not only effective in solid tumor cells in vitro, but also has an excellent killing effect on solid tumor cells in vivo.
patents.assignee: CARSGEN THERAPEUTICS SHANGHAI CO LTD; SHANGHAI CANCER INST; 科济生物医药（上海）有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: Novel engineered cells expressing exogenous IL-21R binding proteins/IL-21 combined with exogenous chemokines to enhance infiltration and killing of solid tumors both in vitro and in vivo. This addresses a key limitation of CAR-T therapies in solid tumors by combining immunomodulatory cytokines with chemokine-driven homing, offering a significant competitive advantage over standard CAR-T cells in the solid tumor indication.

patents.title: T-CELL EXPRESSING CHIMERIC RECEPTOR
patents.abstract: Provided is a T-cell expressing a chimeric receptor, wherein the chimeric receptor specifically recognizes BCMA, and the endogenous TCR molecule and the endogenous MHC molecule are silenced. Also provided is the use of the T-cell in the preparation of a drug for treating BCMA positive tumors.
patents.assignee: CARSGEN THERAPEUTICS CO LTD; 佧珐药业有限公司; 克莱格医学有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes T-cells engineered with BCMA-targeting chimeric antigen receptors (CAR-T) in which both endogenous TCR and MHC molecules are silenced to reduce alloreactivity and improve therapeutic efficacy. The dual silencing of TCR and MHC represents a competitive advancement for off-the-shelf allogeneic CAR-T therapies, potentially enabling universal donor cell products with reduced graft-versus-host disease risk.

patents.title: METHOD FOR TREATING TUMOR USING IMMUNE EFFECTOR CELL
patents.abstract: Provided are an immune effector cell expressing a chimeric antigen receptor that gives individual specific recognition BCMA, and a treatment method applying the immune effector cell. The method can improve the tumor treatment efficacy of the immune effector cell.
patents.assignee: CARSGEN THERAPEUTICS SHANGHAI CO LTD; 科济生物医药（上海）有限公司; 恺兴生命科技（上海）有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent claims immune effector cells expressing a BCMA-targeting chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) with individual-specific recognition capability, combined with methods to improve tumor treatment efficacy. The competitive significance for in vivo CAR-T lies in potential enhancements to BCMA-directed therapy, a validated target in multiple myeloma, though the abstract provides limited detail on the specific mechanisms conferring improved efficacy over existing BCMA CAR-T approaches.

patents.title: Genetically Modified Cell and Its Use
patents.abstract: [0001]    Disclosed in the present invention is a genetically engineered cell, expressing an exogenous receptor that specifically binds to a target antigen and exogenous CCL21, and capable of further expressing an IL-7R binding protein or exogenous IL-7 that promotes cell proliferation. Also disclosed are an expression construct comprising an exogenous CCL21 expression cassette, and a vector containing same, a virus, and a pharmaceutical composition comprising said cell. Also disclosed is an application for the cell, the expression construct, the vector, and the virus in the preparation of drugs for inhibiting tumours or inhibiting pathogens.
patents.assignee: CARSGEN THERAPEUTICS CO LTD [CN]; SHANGHAI CANCER INST [CN]; CAFA THERAPEUTICS LTD [IE]
patents.novelty_summary: The invention combines exogenous CCL21 expression with CAR-T cells to enhance immune cell recruitment and proliferation through IL-7 signaling, creating an engineered cell product with improved tumor-killing capacity. This dual-functionality approach (antigen-targeting receptor + chemokine + growth factor signaling) represents a significant advancement in CAR-T design by addressing both local cell infiltration and proliferative capacity simultaneously.
patents.title_original: GENETISCH VERÄNDERTE ZELLE UND IHRE VERWENDUNG

patents.title: MANIPULIERTE IMMUNEFFEKTORZELLEN UND VERWENDUNG DAVON
patents.abstract: A geneticall engineered cell. The cell expresses an exogenous receptor binding to an antigen, and expresses increased RUNX3 or exogenous RUNX3. Also provided are a use of the cell and a method for treating tumors.
patents.assignee: CARSGEN THERAPEUTICS CO LTD [CN]; SHANGHAI CANCER INST [CN]; CAFA THERAPEUTICS LTD [IE]
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes genetically engineered immune effector cells expressing an exogenous antigen-binding receptor combined with elevated or exogenous RUNX3 expression. RUNX3 is a transcription factor that enhances T cell differentiation and anti-tumor function; combining it with CAR or TCR engineering represents a novel approach to improve CAR-T persistence, cytotoxic function, and tumor control in vivo.

patents.title: Method and Composition for Cancer Treatment
patents.abstract: 본 발명은 면역 효과기 세포의 조성물을 제공하고, 여기서, 상기 면역 효과기 세포의 조성물은 처음 사용량의 면역 효과기 세포 및 후속 사용량의 면역 효과기 세포, 및 이러한 면역 효과기 세포의 조성물을 포함하는 치료용 키트를 포함한다.
patents.assignee: CARSGEN THERAPEUTICS LTD [CN]; SHANGHAI CANCER INST [CN]; 카르스젠 테라퓨틱스 리미티드
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes a composition of immune effector cells with staged dosing regimens (initial and subsequent doses) and associated therapeutic kits for tumor treatment. The competitive significance lies in the dosing strategy and formulation approach for cell therapy administration, potentially optimizing therapeutic efficacy through sequential cell delivery rather than single-dose administration.
patents.title_original: 종양 치료 방법 및 조성물

patents.title: COMBINATION OF CELLULAR IMMUNOTHERAPY
patents.abstract: [0001]    Provided in the present invention is a method for treating tumor. An immune effector cell and a second treatment agent are applied to individual suffering from tumor, wherein the immune effector cell expresses a receptor for recognizing tumor antigen, and wherein the second treatment agent is a compound of formula I or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof.
patents.assignee: CARSGEN THERAPEUTICS CO LTD [CN]; SHANGHAI CANCER INST [CN]; CRAGE MEDICAL CO LTD [HK]
patents.novelty_summary: The patent combines immune effector cells expressing tumor antigen-recognizing receptors (consistent with CAR-T technology) with a second small molecule treatment agent (formula I compound). The competitive significance lies in a combination therapy approach that may enhance anti-tumor efficacy through synergistic mechanisms between engineered T cell immunotherapy and pharmacological co-treatment, addressing a clinically relevant strategy to improve CAR-T therapeutic outcomes.

patents.title: Regulation of IL-12 Expression by SynNotch Receptor
patents.abstract: 本発明は、免疫治療分野に属し、具体的にバイナリーベクターおよびｓｙｎＮｏｔｃｈ技術を使用して標的抗原依存性調節サイトカインの発現の提供により、サイトカインを部分的に放出してＴ細胞の機能を増強し、同時にサイトカインの非特異的毒性副作用を低減する。合成ｎｏｔｃｈ受容体を使用して、プラスミドベクターを構築することにより、サイトカインの局所分泌を実現する。１つのプラスミドベクターは、標的抗原を認識するための特異的抗体を細胞外ドメインとして使用し、Ｎｏｔｃｈコアは膜貫通ドメインとｎｏｔｃｈ受容体上の特異的の酵素切断部位を含み、ＧＡＬ４ＶＰ６４は細胞内ドメインとして使用される。標的抗原が認識されると、ｎｏｔｃｈの酵素切断部位は対応する酵素によって認識され、細胞内転写因子ＧＡＬ４ＶＰ６４を加水分解および切断される。別のプラスミドベクターは、ＧＡＬ４転写因子のＤＮＡ認識結合領域ＧＡＬ４ＵＡＳおよび対応する標的遺伝子を活性化する最小プロモーターを有し、ＧＡＬ４ＶＰ６４が加水分解および切断された後、結合領域に結合して、後続の遺伝子の転写を活性化して、ＩＬ１２を発現しかつ細胞外に分泌する。
patents.assignee: カースゲン  セラピューティクス  カンパニー  リミテッドＣＡＲＳＧＥＮ  ＴＨＥＲＡＰＥＵＴＩＣＳ  ＣＯ．，  ＬＴＤ．; 上海市腫瘤研究所ＳＨＡＮＧＨＡＩ  ＣＡＮＣＥＲ  ＩＮＳＴＩＴＵＴＥ
patents.novelty_summary: This patent describes a synthetic Notch receptor-based binary vector system for antigen-dependent, localized IL-12 expression in T cells. The innovation lies in using a split transcriptional activator (GAL4-VP64) architecture triggered by engineered Notch signaling to achieve target antigen-conditional cytokine secretion, thereby enhancing T cell function while reducing off-target toxicity—a significant advance for safer, more controlled CAR-T immunotherapy.
patents.title_original: ＳｙｎＮｏｔｃｈ受容体によるＩＬ１２の発現調節

patents.title: Binding Unit Targeting Fibroblast Activation Protein α and Its Applications
patents.abstract: 本発明は、ＦＡＰαに特異的に結合する結合ユニット、そのような結合ユニットをコードするポリヌクレオチド、そのようなポリヌクレオチドを含むベクターおよび宿主細胞に関する。本発明はさらに、前記抗原結合ユニットを生成する方法および本発明のＦＡＰα特異的に結合ユニットを使用して疾患を治療する方法に関する。本発明のＦＡＰαに特異的に結合する結合ユニットは、ＦＡＰαを発現する腫瘍細胞に効果的に結合でき、前記結合ユニットを含む免疫エフェクター細胞はＦＡＰを発現する腫瘍細胞に対して有意な殺傷能力を示す。【選択図】なし
